table.name: ACADEMIC_TERMS
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of MIT academic terms (Fall, January/IAP, Spring, Summer) from 1995 through ~2030, one row per term, with calendar dates (term start/end, first/last day of classes, final exams, registration) and administrative year attributes (academic year, degree year, financial aid year). It is the lookup for term codes used across course-offering, subject, library, and time-dimension tables.

ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.name: Term key
ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.description: Primary key; term code in the form YYYYTT (e.g. 1995FA = Fall 1995, JA = January/IAP term, SP = Spring, SU = Summer). Identical in value to TERM_CODE.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: Academic year (ending year)
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Calendar year in which the academic year ends (e.g. 2010 for Academic Year 2009-2010). Four terms share each value.

ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.name: Academic year description
ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.description: Human-readable academic year label, e.g. 'Academic Year 2009-2010'.

ADD_DATE.name: Last date to add a subject
ADD_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) by which a subject may be added for the term; null for January and Summer terms (50% null).

DEGREE_YEAR.name: Degree year
DEGREE_YEAR.description: Year in which degrees conferred for this term count; for Fall/Spring/January it equals the academic year, for Summer it is the following year (e.g. 2023SU -> 2024). Null for some terms.

DROP_DATE.name: Last date to drop a subject
DROP_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) by which a subject may be dropped without penalty; null for January and Summer terms.

FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.name: Financial aid year
FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.description: Financial-aid award year the term belongs to; matches DEGREE_YEAR in the samples (Summer term maps to the following year). Null for some terms.

FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: First day of classes
FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the first class day of the term; null for some terms (e.g. older January terms).

GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.name: Graduate award end date
GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.description: End date of the graduate student award/stipend period covering the term (e.g. 31-AUG for summer, 15-JAN for fall). Null for many terms.

GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.name: Graduate award start date
GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.description: Start date of the graduate student award/stipend period covering the term (e.g. 01-JUN, 01-SEP, 16-JAN). Null for many terms.

IS_CURRENT_TERM.name: Is current term flag
IS_CURRENT_TERM.description: Y/N flag; exactly one row is 'Y', marking the currently active term.

IS_REGULAR_TERM.name: Is regular term flag
IS_REGULAR_TERM.description: Y/N flag; 'Y' for the regular Fall and Spring terms (72 rows), 'N' for January and Summer terms (72 rows).

LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: Last day of classes
LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last class day of the term; null for some terms.

LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.name: Last day of final exams
LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last final exam day; populated for all 144 terms.

PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.name: Pre-registration start date
PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which pre-registration opens for the term (e.g. 01-MAY for fall, early December for spring).

REGISTRATION_DAY.name: Registration day
REGISTRATION_DAY.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of (official) registration day for the term; populated for all terms.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Term code YYYYTT (FA/JA/SP/SU), same value as ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY; the join key referenced by most other tables (SUBJECT_OFFERED, TIME_MONTH, etc.).

TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Term description
TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'January Term 2009-2010', 'Summer Term 2023'.

TERM_END_DATE.name: Term end date
TERM_END_DATE.description: Official end date of the term (DD-MON-YY), typically the last final-exam day.

TERM_SELECTOR.name: Term selector
TERM_SELECTOR.description: Concatenation of term code and description, e.g. '2010JA-January Term 2009-2010'; used as a display/join selector (one-to-one with ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL).

TERM_START_DATE.name: Term start date
TERM_START_DATE.description: Official start date of the term (DD-MON-YY).

TERM_STATUS.name: Term status
TERM_STATUS.description: Relative status of the term: 'Previous' (past), 'Current' (active), 'Future' (upcoming), or 'Unspecified' (likely far-future terms not yet scheduled).

TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.name: Term status indicator
TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.description: Single-letter code for TERM_STATUS: C = Current, P = Previous, F = Future; null where status is 'Unspecified'.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (full snapshot load).

table.name: ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL
table.purpose: Dimension/lookup table of all MIT academic terms (Fall, Spring, Summer, January) from 1951 through ~2030, with key dates (start/end, class days, registration, exams) and academic/degree/financial-aid year mappings. One row per term. Referenced by many course-offering, subject, and student tables via TERM_CODE. Likely a superset of ACADEMIC_TERMS (one-to-one on TERM_CODE).

ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.name: Term key
ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY.description: Same value as TERM_CODE (e.g. 1953FA, 2016SU): 4-digit year + FA/SP/SU term suffix. Duplicate of the primary key.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: Academic year (start year)
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Calendar year in which the academic year begins; e.g. 1953FA belongs to academic year 1953 (i.e. 1952-1953). Ranges 1951-2030.

ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.name: Academic year description
ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC.description: Human-readable academic year label, e.g. 'Academic Year 1952-1953'.

DEGREE_YEAR.name: Degree year
DEGREE_YEAR.description: Year used for degree/conferral accounting for the term; typically the spring/summer year of the academic year (e.g. 2016SU -> 2017). 'XXXX' (17 rows, mostly older terms) means not applicable/unknown. Alternative reading: it could instead be the graduation class year label (the year printed with the class, e.g. '2017' for students graduating in that academic year), which would coincide with the conferral year in most cases; the join evidence (referencing tables use only TERM_CODE) does not distinguish these.

FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.name: Financial aid year
FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR.description: Year used for financial-aid reporting for the term; same values as DEGREE_YEAR (e.g. 2016SU -> 2017), 'XXXX' for older terms. Alternative reading: it could be the financial-aid award year label (the year the aid cohort graduates) rather than a reporting period year; the referencing tables (TIME_DAY, TIME_MONTH carry their own financial aid year attributes) do not distinguish these.

FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: First day of classes
FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the first day of classes for the term; null for older terms (16% null).

GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.name: Graduate award end date
GRADUATE_AWARD_END_DATE.description: End date of the graduate award/fellowship appointment period covering the term (e.g. 31-AUG-16 for Summer 2016); null for ~52% of terms (mostly older and spring/fall terms). Alternative reading: it could be the end of the term's graduate-stipend/billing period rather than a fellowship appointment; no joined table provides evidence to decide.

GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.name: Graduate award start date
GRADUATE_AWARD_START_DATE.description: Start date of the graduate award/fellowship appointment period covering the term (e.g. 01-JUN-16 for Summer 2016); null for ~52% of terms. Alternative reading: it could be the start of the term's graduate-stipend/billing period rather than a fellowship appointment; no joined table provides evidence to decide.

IS_CURRENT_TERM.name: Is current term flag
IS_CURRENT_TERM.description: Y/N flag marking the one term currently in progress; exactly one row is 'Y'.

LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.name: Last day of classes
LAST_DAY_OF_CLASSES.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last day of classes for the term; null for older terms.

LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.name: Last day of final exams
LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last final exam of the term; equals or slightly follows TERM_END_DATE.

PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.name: Pre-registration start date
PRE_REGISTRATION_START_DAY.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) on which pre-registration opens for the term (e.g. 02-MAY-16 for Summer 2016); null for ~39% of terms.

REGISTRATION_DAY.name: Registration day
REGISTRATION_DAY.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of registration day for the term; equals TERM_START_DATE in sampled rows.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code (primary key)
TERM_CODE.description: Primary key: 4-digit year + FA/SP/SU suffix (e.g. 1953FA, 2016SU). Referenced by many subject/course/student tables.

TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Term description
TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable term name, e.g. 'Fall Term 1952-1953', 'Summer Term 2016'.

TERM_END_DATE.name: Term end date
TERM_END_DATE.description: Official end date (DD-MON-YY) of the term, typically the last final-exam day.

TERM_SELECTOR.name: Term selector
TERM_SELECTOR.description: Concatenation of TERM_CODE and TERM_DESCRIPTION (e.g. '1953FA-Fall Term 1952-1953'), used as a display selector; joins one-to-one to ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_SELECTOR.

TERM_START_DATE.name: Term start date
TERM_START_DATE.description: Official start date (DD-MON-YY) of the term.

TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.name: Term status indicator
TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.description: Single-letter code for the term type/period, joined to ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_INDICATOR: P = Summer Term, C = Fall Term, F = January (IAP) Term. 'P' dominates because summer terms are most numerous.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (full snapshot load).

table.name: ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER
table.purpose: Maps SIS term-role parameters (current, previous, upcoming term) to specific academic terms, with each term's dates and a flag marking the current term. Each row is one term-role assignment (e.g., SIS_CURRENT_TERM -> 2025FA).

IS_CURRENT_TERM.name: is_current_term
IS_CURRENT_TERM.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this row's term is the current academic term (Y for the SIS_CURRENT_TERM row, N otherwise).

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code in YYYY+session format (e.g., 2025FA = Fall 2025, 2024SU = Summer 2024, 2025JA = January/IAP 2025). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: term_description
TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable name of the term, e.g., 'Fall Term 2024-2025', 'January Term 2024-2025', 'Summer Term 2024'.

TERM_END_DATE.name: term_end_date
TERM_END_DATE.description: Last day of the term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 20-DEC-24).

TERM_INDICATOR.name: term_status_indicator
TERM_INDICATOR.description: Single-letter code for the term's role: C = current term, P = previous term, F = future/upcoming term. Referenced by ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR and ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR.

TERM_LAST_DAY_BEFORE_NEXT_TERM.name: term_last_day_before_next_term
TERM_LAST_DAY_BEFORE_NEXT_TERM.description: Last calendar day belonging to this term before the next term begins, DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 05-JAN-25 for the fall term, the day before the January term starts on 06-JAN-25).

TERM_PARAMETER.name: term_parameter
TERM_PARAMETER.description: SIS parameter name identifying the term's role: SIS_CURRENT_TERM, SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM, or SIS_UPCOMING_TERM.

TERM_START_DATE.name: term_start_date
TERM_START_DATE.description: First day of the term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 03-SEP-24).

table.name: BUILDINGS
table.purpose: Campus building directory (MIT facilities/space data warehouse): one row per building with its number/key, name, street address, and gross and assignable square footage. Referenced by floor, room, and address tables.

BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.name: assignable_square_footage
BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.description: Total assignable (usable/occupiable) floor area of the building in square feet. Always less than or equal to gross square footage; 0 for some buildings.

BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.name: gross_square_footage
BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.description: Total gross floor area of the building in square feet, including non-assignable space (walls, corridors, mechanical).

BUILDING_COUNTER.name: building_counter
BUILDING_COUNTER.description: Constant value 1 on every row; likely a dummy counter used for row-count aggregation in reporting (e.g., summing to count buildings). Alternative reading: a sequence/ordinal with no analytical meaning.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Primary key identifying the building; matches the building number (e.g. 'W79', 'E52', 'NE47'). Referenced by FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_FLOOR, and FAC_ROOMS.

BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS.name: mailing_address
BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS.description: Mailing (postal) address of the building, as distinct from its street address; the facilities address tables (FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS / FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS) track street, mailing, E911, and parcel addresses per building, suggesting this is the mailing-purpose address. Alternative reading: a free-form address string that may duplicate the street address.

BUILDING_NAME.name: building_name
BUILDING_NAME.description: Official building name (e.g. 'Simmons Hall', 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'); some rows use generic labels like 'Building 41'. A few names repeat (e.g. Wallace Astrophysical Observatory, 6 rows), likely multiple structures sharing a name.

BUILDING_NUMBER.name: building_number
BUILDING_NUMBER.description: MIT building number/code (e.g. 'W79', 'E52', 'OC19Q'), identical to BUILDING_KEY on these rows; used as the join key to FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING and as parent building number in those tables.

BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS.name: building_street_address
BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS.description: Street address of the building (e.g. '229 VASSAR ST', '50 MEMORIAL DR'); multiple buildings can share an address.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' across all rows, indicating a full snapshot load on December 19, 2024.

table.name: CIP
table.purpose: NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) codes — the standard taxonomy of academic program/major codes, with versions from 1990 to 2020. Each row is one CIP program (6-digit) with its 4-digit intermediate and 2-digit category groupings, plus change notes between CIP revisions. Referenced by course-catalog tables (CIP_WITH_VERSION, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION) to tag courses/programs with CIP codes.

CATEGORY_CODE.name: CIP 2-digit category code
CATEGORY_CODE.description: First two digits of the CIP code: the broad instructional category (e.g. 16 = Foreign Languages, 22 = Legal Professions, 43 = Homeland Security/Law Enforcement). The detected join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a spurious numeric coincidence — space-usage labels (e.g. 'CLNT MEETING ROOM') are unrelated to CIP categories and should be ignored.

CATEGORY_TITLE.name: CIP category title
CATEGORY_TITLE.description: Title of the 2-digit CIP category (e.g. 'FOREIGN LANGUAGES AND LITERATURES', 'LEGAL PROFESSIONS AND STUDIES'). More distinct values (87) than category codes (52) because titles vary across CIP versions (e.g. 'HEALTH PROFESSIONS AND RELATED PROGRAMS' vs. 'HEALTH PROFESSIONS RESIDENCY/FELLOWSHIP PROGRAMS').

FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.name: CIP 4-digit intermediate code
FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.description: Middle two digits of the CIP code combined with the category, forming the 4-digit intermediate grouping (e.g. 1612, 2202, 4301). Not unique because codes repeat across CIP versions.

FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.name: CIP 4-digit title
FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.description: Title of the 4-digit CIP intermediate grouping (e.g. 'Classical and Ancient Near Eastern Languages and Literatures', 'Criminal Justice and Corrections').

NOTE.name: CIP revision change note
NOTE.description: Notes describing changes between CIP revisions: whether a code is new in a given year, had no substantive changes, or was moved from/to another code (e.g. 'Moved from 51.2931', 'New in 2020'). Null for codes with no recorded change history.

PROGRAM_CODE.name: CIP 6-digit program code
PROGRAM_CODE.description: Full 6-digit CIP program code (primary key), e.g. 161201 = Classics and Classical Languages. Referenced by CIP_WITH_VERSION and SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE to classify courses/programs.

PROGRAM_TITLE.name: CIP program title
PROGRAM_TITLE.description: Official title of the 6-digit CIP program (e.g. 'Transportation Law', 'Financial Forensics and Fraud Investigation'). Slight duplicates arise from title changes across CIP versions.

VERSION.name: CIP revision year
VERSION.description: CIP revision edition the row belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020. The table holds the union of codes across these editions.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (Oracle-style 'DD-MON-YY' text). Two loads: 11-JUN-14 (pre-2020 CIP rows) and 17-MAY-23 (2020 CIP rows).

table.name: CIP_WITH_VERSION
table.purpose: A versioned copy of the U.S. NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP): each row is one instructional program code (6-digit CIP) as defined in a given CIP revision year (1990, 2000, 2010, 2020), with its 4-digit intermediate title and 2-digit category title. The table tracks how program codes and titles changed across CIP editions.

CATEGORY_CODE.name: CIP 2-digit category code
CATEGORY_CODE.description: The 2-digit CIP category (leading two digits of the program code), e.g. 43 = Protective Services, 12 = Personal and Miscellaneous Services. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a coincidental numeric match (e.g. 38 = 'CLNT MEETING ROOM') and is semantically invalid; this column does not reference space usage.

CATEGORY_TITLE.name: CIP category title
CATEGORY_TITLE.description: Title of the 2-digit CIP category, e.g. 'PROTECTIVE SERVICES', 'EDUCATION'. Mixed case reflects the style of the CIP edition the row was loaded from.

CIP_WITH_VERSION_KEY.name: Surrogate primary key
CIP_WITH_VERSION_KEY.description: Concatenation of the 6-digit program code and the 4-digit version year (e.g. 430107 + 1990 = 4301071990). Uniquely identifies a program code within a CIP edition; it is the table's primary key.

FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.name: CIP 4-digit intermediate code
FOUR_DIGIT_CODE.description: The 4-digit CIP series code (middle two digits of the program code), e.g. 4301 = Criminal Justice and Corrections.

FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.name: CIP 4-digit series title
FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE.description: Title of the 4-digit CIP series, e.g. 'Criminal Justice and Corrections', 'Medical Residency Programs'. Case varies with CIP edition.

PROGRAM_CODE.name: CIP 6-digit program code
PROGRAM_CODE.description: The 6-digit CIP program code (e.g. 430107 = Law Enforcement/Police Science). References CIP.PROGRAM_CODE in the unversioned CIP table.

PROGRAM_TITLE.name: CIP program title
PROGRAM_TITLE.description: Title of the 6-digit instructional program, e.g. 'LAW ENFORCEMENT/POLICE SCIENCE', 'Veterinary Surgery'. Case varies with CIP edition.

VERSION.name: CIP edition year
VERSION.description: The CIP revision edition this row's definition belongs to: 1990, 2000, 2010, or 2020.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (Oracle DD-MON-YY format); each CIP edition was loaded on a single date (e.g. 2020 edition loaded 17-MAY-23).

table.name: CIS_COURSE_CATALOG
table.purpose: MIT course catalog snapshot (CIS = Course Information System): one row per subject per academic year, with title, description, units, grading, offering terms, instructors, and requirement attributes as of the effective term.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: academic_year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Academic year of the catalog entry (2002-2009), stored as a 4-digit string.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: communication_requirement_code
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code flagging the subject as fulfilling a Communication Intensive (CI) requirement; only value 'CIM' (Communication Intensive Major). Null when not applicable.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: communication_requirement_description
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major'.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT department/course code owning the subject (e.g. 15=Management, 6=EECS, 21F=Global Studies & Languages). References SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the owning department, e.g. 'Management', 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'.

DESIGN_UNITS.name: design_units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Number of units credited as design work within the subject (MIT unit breakdown: lecture/lab/preparation/design); 0 for almost all subjects.

EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.name: effective_term_code
EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.description: Term (YYYY + FA/JA/SP/SU) from which this catalog record is effective; references ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE.

EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.name: equivalent_subjects
EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.description: Free-text list of subjects considered equivalent to this one for credit purposes; blank when none. Plausible reading only - could also mean 'substitutable subjects' in a narrower sense.

FALL_INSTRUCTORS.name: fall_instructors
FALL_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor name(s) teaching the subject in the fall term; 'Staff' when unassigned; multiple instructors comma-separated.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE.name: gir_requirement_code
GIR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code identifying which General Institute Requirement (GIR) the subject fulfills (e.g. REST, LAB, partial GIR categories); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE. Null when the subject fulfills no GIR.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: gir_requirement_description
GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GIR_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Restricted Electives in Science & Technology' or a lab GIR category.

GLOBAL_COUNTRIES.name: global_countries
GLOBAL_COUNTRIES.description: Country or countries the subject's content/global focus relates to (for global-education designated subjects); blank for most rows. Plausible reading only - could instead list countries of travel/study components.

GLOBAL_REGIONS.name: global_regions
GLOBAL_REGIONS.description: World region(s) the subject's global focus relates to (e.g. Asia, Europe, Latin America); blank for most rows. Plausible reading only - could instead be a region-of-travel field.

GRADE_RULE.name: grade_rule_code
GRADE_RULE.description: Code for repeat/credit rule: R=repeatable for credit, N=not repeatable, J=continuing and repeatable, T=continuing.

GRADE_RULE_DESC.name: grade_rule_description
GRADE_RULE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GRADE_RULE, e.g. 'Can be repeated for credit'.

GRADE_TYPE.name: grade_type_code
GRADE_TYPE.description: Grading option code: L=letter graded, P=pass/D/fail (P/D/F).

GRADE_TYPE_DESC.name: grade_type_description
GRADE_TYPE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GRADE_TYPE: 'Letter graded' or 'P/D/F'.

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: hass_requirement_code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code identifying the HASS (Humanities, Arts, and Social Sciences) category the subject fulfills (e.g. HASS-A, HASS-H, HASS-S); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE. Null when not a HASS subject.

HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: hass_requirement_description
HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of HASS_ATTRIBUTE, e.g. 'Humanities', 'Arts', 'Social Sciences'.

HGN_CODE.name: level_code
HGN_CODE.description: Subject level code: U=Undergraduate, G=Graduate, H=High Graduate (graduate-level subject open to advanced undergraduates).

HGN_EXCEPT.name: level_exception
HGN_EXCEPT.description: Exception or note to the subject's level code (HGN_CODE), e.g. restrictions on which student levels may enroll despite the nominal level. Plausible reading only - could also be a second level code for subjects cross-listed at two levels.

IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.name: is_offered_fall_term
IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the fall term.

IS_OFFERED_IAP.name: is_offered_iap
IS_OFFERED_IAP.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered during Independent Activities Period (January).

IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.name: is_offered_spring_term
IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the spring term.

IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.name: is_offered_summer_term
IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the summer term.

IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.name: is_offered_this_year
IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered at all during this academic year (null for some rows).

IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.name: is_printed_in_bulletin
IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.description: Y/N flag: subject description appears in the printed course bulletin.

IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.name: is_variable_units
IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.description: Y/N flag: subject carries a variable number of units (arranged with instructor).

JOINT_SUBJECTS.name: joint_subjects
JOINT_SUBJECTS.description: Free-text list of subject IDs jointly offered with this subject (same content, multiple listings across departments); blank when none. Plausible reading only - could also mean subjects that must be taken together.

LAB_UNITS.name: lab_units
LAB_UNITS.description: Lab portion of the subject's unit count; always 0 in this extract (no lab-unit subjects present).

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the catalog record was last updated (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: lecture_units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Lecture/recitation portion of the subject's weekly unit count (0-6).

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the master/primary listing when this subject is a joint or cross-listed offering; otherwise likely equals SUBJECT_ID. Plausible reading only - could instead be a warehouse surrogate key for the subject.

MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.name: meets_with_subjects
MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.description: Free-text list of subject IDs whose classes meet together with this subject (shared classroom/instruction, distinct credit); blank when none. Plausible reading only - could overlap with joint-listing semantics.

ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.name: online_page_number
ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.description: Page number of the subject's entry in the online version of the course bulletin/catalog. Plausible reading only - could be a display ordering number rather than a true page reference.

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: preparation_units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Preparation/homework portion of the subject's weekly unit count (0-18).

PREREQUISITES.name: prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Free-text prerequisite statement, e.g. '7.03, 7.05, 7.06' or 'Permission of instructor'.

PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.name: print_subject_id
PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject identifier as printed in the bulletin; usually equals SUBJECT_ID but may show ranges (e.g. '7.340–7.349') or blanks.

SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.name: school_wide_electives
SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.description: Flag or code indicating the subject counts as a school-wide elective (acceptable toward degree requirements across the school's programs). Plausible reading only - could be a list of schools for which it is an elective.

SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.name: source_subject_id
SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject identifier as recorded in the source system; nearly identical to SUBJECT_ID.

SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.name: spring_instructors
SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor name(s) teaching the subject in the spring term; 'Staff' when unassigned. Identical distribution to FALL_INSTRUCTORS suggests it may be copied rather than term-specific.

STATUS_CHANGE.name: status_change
STATUS_CHANGE.description: Code or note describing a change in the subject's catalog status (e.g. new, revised, discontinued, renumbered) relative to the prior year's catalog. Plausible reading only - could also be a simple active/inactive status flag.

SUBJECT_CODE.name: subject_code
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Course/subject prefix (department number or letter code, e.g. '15', '21F', 'SP'); references SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.name: subject_description
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: Full catalog description of the subject; null for many rows (special topics/thesis subjects often lack one).

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Full MIT subject number (course number + subject number, e.g. '7.414', 'CMS.THU'); the natural key of the catalog entry.

SUBJECT_NUMBER.name: subject_number
SUBJECT_NUMBER.description: The number part of the subject ID within the course (e.g. '951', 'THU', 'NIV').

SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.name: subject_short_title
SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.description: Abbreviated subject title used in listings (e.g. 'CMS THESIS').

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Full subject title (e.g. 'Undergraduate Thesis in Comparative Media Studies').

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.name: supervisor_attribute_code
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for supervisor-based subject types: UROP (undergraduate research), THG (graduate thesis), THU (undergraduate thesis); null otherwise.

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: supervisor_attribute_description
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE: 'UROP subject', 'Grad Thesis', 'Undergrad Thesis'.

TERM_DURATION.name: term_duration
TERM_DURATION.description: Code indicating the duration of the subject's offering within a term (e.g. full term vs. first/second half-term). Plausible reading only - could instead be the number of terms the subject runs.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: total_units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (0-24); 0 for variable-unit subjects.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.name: tuition_attribute_code
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.description: Tuition-related attribute code: RESH=pre-thesis research subject, NTRN=internship; references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: tuition_attribute_description
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of TUITION_ATTRIBUTE: 'Pre-thesis Research Subject', 'Internship'.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date this row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this extract.

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: writing_requirement_code
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code flagging fulfillment of the MIT Writing Requirement; only value 'WRT2' (Phase II). Null when not applicable.

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: writing_requirement_description
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE: 'Writing Requirement, Phase II'.

table.name: CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE
table.purpose: Lookup table of MIT HASS/GIR Humanities-Arts-Social-Sciences attribute codes (e.g. HA, HH, HS, HD1-HD5, HE) used to tag subjects in the course catalog; each row defines one attribute code with its bulletin description, form description, and web icon details. Group H codes apply to students entering Fall 2010 or later (HASS_ATTRIBUTE), group G codes to earlier students (GIR_ATTRIBUTE). It is referenced by SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE to classify subjects by HASS category (Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, HASS-D distribution, Elective).

CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP.name: attribute_group
CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP.description: Group flag distinguishing the two attribute schemes: 'H' = HASS_ATTRIBUTE (students entering Fall 2010 or later), 'G' = GIR_ATTRIBUTE (students entering prior to Fall 2010).

CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_NOTE.name: attribute_group_note
CIS_ATTRIBUTE_GROUP_NOTE.description: Human-readable explanation of the group code: 'HASS_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering in Fall 2010 or later' or 'GIR_ATTRIBUTE, for students entering prior to Fall 2010'.

DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN.name: bulletin_description
DESCRIPTION_IN_BULLETIN.description: How the attribute is displayed in the course bulletin, e.g. 'HASS-A', 'HASS-D 2', 'HASS-A, HASS-H'.

DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM.name: form_description
DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM.description: How the attribute is displayed on forms/registration UI, e.g. 'HASS Arts', 'HASS-D, Category 2', 'Arts + Humanities'.

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: hass_attribute_code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: The attribute code itself (HA, HH, HS, HD1-HD5, HE, and combinations like 'HA,HH'); joins to SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE to tag subjects with HASS categories.

ICON_GIF_NAME.name: icon_gif_name
ICON_GIF_NAME.description: Filename of the GIF icon used to display the attribute on the web (e.g. hassS.gif, hassAH.gif); null for rows without an icon.

ICON_HEIGHT.name: icon_height
ICON_HEIGHT.description: Height in pixels of the attribute's display icon; always 16 when present.

ICON_WIDTH.name: icon_width
ICON_WIDTH.description: Width in pixels of the attribute's display icon; 16 for single-letter icons, 35 for two-letter combination icons. The detected join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious (numeric coincidence), not a real reference.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the row was last modified in the source system (Oracle DD-MON-YY format).

LAST_UPDATE_USER.name: last_update_user
LAST_UPDATE_USER.description: Username of the person who last updated the row (always 'PETECHOI' in this snapshot).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows 19-DEC-24).

table.name: COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: MIT course catalog offering: one row per subject (and per section, when sectioned) per academic term, with catalog attributes such as units, grading, instructors, meeting time/place, and requirement attributes. Related to SUBJECT_OFFERED / LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED / TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED in the same warehouse.

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: academic_year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Academic year of the offering term (e.g. 2024 for 2024SP/2024FA), 2002-2025.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: communication_requirement_code
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for the Communication Intensive requirement attribute (CIM/CIH/CIHW); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: communication_requirement_description
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'Communication Intensive Major').

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT department/course code owning the subject (e.g. 6 = EECS, 15 = Management); references SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the owning department (e.g. 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci').

DESIGN_UNITS.name: design_units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Design portion of the subject's credit units (MIT unit system: 1 unit ~ 1 hour/week); 0 for most subjects.

EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.name: effective_term_code
EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.description: Catalog term from which this subject record is effective (e.g. 2016FA); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.name: equivalent_subjects
EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.description: List of other subject numbers considered equivalent to this subject (comma-separated).

FALL_INSTRUCTORS.name: fall_instructors
FALL_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor(s) teaching the subject in the fall term, as 'Initial. Surname' strings; 'Staff' when unassigned.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE.name: gir_attribute_code
GIR_ATTRIBUTE.description: General Institute Requirement attribute code(s) (e.g. REST, LAB, HE, CAL2); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: gir_attribute_description
GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GIR_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'HASS Elective', 'Institute Lab').

GLOBAL_COUNTRIES.name: global_countries
GLOBAL_COUNTRIES.description: Country or countries (pipe-separated) where the subject is taught, for global/travel subjects; null otherwise.

GLOBAL_REGIONS.name: global_regions
GLOBAL_REGIONS.description: Region(s) (pipe-separated, e.g. Asia, Europe, 'Global (all regions)') for global/travel subjects.

GRADE_RULE.name: grade_rule_code
GRADE_RULE.description: Code for repeat-for-credit rule: N=not repeatable, R=repeatable, J=continuing and repeatable, T=continuing.

GRADE_TYPE.name: grade_type_code
GRADE_TYPE.description: Grading basis code: L=letter graded, P=pass/D/fail.

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: hass_attribute_code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: HASS requirement category code(s) (HA arts, HH humanities, HS social sciences, HE elective); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

HGN_CODE.name: level_code
HGN_CODE.description: Subject level: U=undergraduate, G=graduate, H=high graduate.

HGN_EXCEPT.name: level_exception
HGN_EXCEPT.description: Exception clause to the H level, listing course numbers for which the subject counts differently (e.g. '(H except 18)').

IS_DESIGN_SECTION.name: is_design_section
IS_DESIGN_SECTION.description: Y/N flag: this row is a design section of the subject.

IS_LAB_SECTION.name: is_lab_section
IS_LAB_SECTION.description: Y/N flag: this row is a lab section.

IS_LECTURE_SECTION.name: is_lecture_section
IS_LECTURE_SECTION.description: Y/N flag: this row is a lecture section.

IS_MASTER_SECTION.name: is_master_section
IS_MASTER_SECTION.description: Y/N flag: this row is the master (parent) record of the subject, as opposed to a specific section (SECTION_ID 000).

IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.name: is_offered_fall
IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the fall term.

IS_OFFERED_IAP.name: is_offered_iap
IS_OFFERED_IAP.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in Independent Activities Period (January).

IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.name: is_offered_spring
IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the spring term.

IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.name: is_offered_summer
IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the summer term.

IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.name: is_offered_this_year
IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the current catalog year.

IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.name: is_printed_in_bulletin
IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.description: Whether the subject appears in the printed course bulletin: Y=yes, N=no, S=possibly a special/short form (only 1 row; exact meaning of 'S' unresolved).

IS_RECITATION_SECTION.name: is_recitation_section
IS_RECITATION_SECTION.description: Y/N flag: this row is a recitation section.

IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.name: is_variable_units
IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.description: Y/N flag: subject carries a variable number of units (arranged with instructor).

JOINT_SUBJECTS.name: joint_subjects
JOINT_SUBJECTS.description: List of subject numbers with which this subject is jointly offered (the 'J' cross-listings).

LAB_UNITS.name: lab_units
LAB_UNITS.description: Lab portion of the subject's credit units.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the subject record was last updated in the source system (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: lecture_units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Lecture portion of the subject's credit units.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number of the master/parent subject this row belongs to (differs from SUBJECT_ID for cross-listed or sectioned subjects); null for master rows.

MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.name: meets_with_subjects
MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.description: Other subject numbers whose classes this subject meets with (shared classroom).

MEET_PLACE.name: meeting_place
MEET_PLACE.description: Classroom (building-room, e.g. 'E51-350') or 'VIRTUAL' where/when the section meets.

MEET_TIME.name: meeting_time
MEET_TIME.description: Meeting pattern, e.g. 'TR11-12.30' = Tue/Thu 11:00-12:30; '*TO BE ARRANGED' when unscheduled.

ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.name: online_catalog_url
ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.description: URL of the online catalog page where the subject description appears (student.mit.edu catalog).

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: preparation_units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Preparation/homework portion of the subject's credit units.

PREREQUISITES.name: prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Free-text prerequisite statement: subject numbers, GIR codes (e.g. GIR:CAL1), and/or 'permission of instructor'.

PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.name: print_subject_id
PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number as printed in the catalog (may include 'J' suffix for joint subjects); differs slightly from SUBJECT_ID.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: responsible_faculty_mit_id
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: responsible_faculty_name
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name ('Surname, Given') of the responsible faculty member.

SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.name: school_wide_electives
SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.description: List of subject numbers forming a school-wide elective group that this subject belongs to (e.g. the x.EPE/x.EPW series).

SECTION_ID.name: section_id
SECTION_ID.description: Section identifier: 000 for the master record, L## lecture, R## recitation, B## lab/design sections; null for non-sectioned subjects.

SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.name: source_subject_id
SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject number in the source system for this row (may differ from SUBJECT_ID for renumbered/cross-listed subjects).

SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.name: spring_instructors
SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor(s) teaching the subject in the spring term; 'Staff' when unassigned.

STATUS_CHANGE.name: status_change
STATUS_CHANGE.description: Catalog status change note for the subject: new subject, removed subject, renumbering history (e.g. 'New subject (2012: New number: 21H.333)').

SUBJECT_CODE.name: subject_code
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Course/subject code prefix (department number, e.g. '6', '21F'); references SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.name: subject_description
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: Catalog text description of the subject's content.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Full MIT subject number (e.g. '6.9120'), the key identifier of the subject.

SUBJECT_NUMBER.name: subject_number
SUBJECT_NUMBER.description: The numeric/suffix part of the subject number after the course code (e.g. '9120', 'THG', 'UR').

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.name: supervisor_attribute_code
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Code for supervisor-approval subject types: UROP, INDP (independent study), THG (graduate thesis), THU (undergraduate thesis).

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering (e.g. 2024SP, 2016SU, 2007JA=IAP); references ACADEMIC_TERMS; null for master/non-term rows.

TERM_DURATION.name: term_duration
TERM_DURATION.description: Portion of the term the subject runs: full term, first half, second half, or partial term.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: total_units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total credit units for the subject (lecture + lab + preparation + design); 0 for variable-unit subjects.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.name: tuition_attribute_code
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.description: Special tuition-related attribute code: RESH (pre-thesis research), NTRN (internship), COOP; references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (constant 19-DEC-24 in this extract).

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: writing_requirement_code
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: Writing Requirement attribute code (WRT1/WRT2); references SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.

WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: writing_requirement_description
WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE (Writing Requirement Phase I/II).

table.name: DRUPAL_COURSE_CATALOG
table.purpose: Flattened MIT subject (course) catalog export for the Drupal course catalog website: one row per subject per term offering, with catalog attributes (units, grading, attributes, prerequisites, instructors, meeting time/place) and per-section flags concatenated into comma-delimited strings. Appears to be a denormalized join of SUBJECT_OFFERED/CIS_COURSE_CATALOG data keyed on subject ID + term code (SO_TERM_CODE).

ACADEMIC_YEAR.name: Academic year
ACADEMIC_YEAR.description: Academic year of the offering term, e.g. 2011 for Spring Term 2010-2011. Matches SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION.

COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.name: Communication requirement attribute code
COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE.description: MIT Communication Intensive attribute code (CIM = Communication Intensive Major, CIH = Communication Intensive HASS). References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Department (course) number
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT department/course number (1=Civil & Environmental Eng, 2=Mechanical Eng, 3=Materials Science, 5=Chemistry, 7=Biology, 8=Physics, 9=Brain & Cognitive Sciences). Same as SUBJECT_CODE.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the department owning the subject; matches DEPARTMENT_CODE.

DESIGN_UNITS.name: Design units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Number of MIT units designated as design units within the subject's total units (0 for most subjects).

EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.name: Effective term code
EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE.description: Term code (e.g. 2016FA) in which this catalog entry became effective. References ACADEMIC_TERMS(_ALL).TERM_CODE.

EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.name: Equivalent subjects
EQUIVALENT_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs considered equivalent to this subject (e.g. '8.022, 8.02X').

FALL_INSTRUCTORS.name: Fall term instructors
FALL_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor names for the fall offering, comma-separated; 'Staff' when unassigned. Abbreviated MIT style (e.g. 'A. Kemp').

GIR_ATTRIBUTE.name: General Institute Requirement attribute code
GIR_ATTRIBUTE.description: GIR attribute code (REST, LAB, LAB2, HE, PHY1, PHY2, etc.) indicating which MIT General Institute Requirement the subject satisfies. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.

GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: GIR attribute description
GIR_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of GIR_ATTRIBUTE (e.g. 'Institute Lab', 'Physics I').

GLOBAL_REGIONS.name: Global regions scope
GLOBAL_REGIONS.description: Only value 'Global (all regions)'; appears to be a scope flag for globally-offered subjects, but with a single non-null value its real semantics are unclear.

GRADE_RULE.name: Grade rule code
GRADE_RULE.description: Code for repeat-for-credit rule: N = not repeatable, R = repeatable, J = continuing and repeatable, T = continuing.

GRADE_TYPE.name: Grade type code
GRADE_TYPE.description: L = letter graded, P = P/D/F (pass/no-record grading option).

HASS_ATTRIBUTE.name: HASS attribute code
HASS_ATTRIBUTE.description: HASS (Humanities, Arts, Social Sciences) requirement category code: HS = Social Sciences, HH = Humanities, HE = Elective.

HGN_CODE.name: Level code (H/G/N)
HGN_CODE.description: Subject level: U = Undergraduate, G = Graduate, H = High Graduate (graduate-level subject open to advanced undergraduates).

HGN_EXCEPT.name: Level exception note
HGN_EXCEPT.description: Exception note to the HGN level, e.g. '(H except 1, 18)'. Only one non-null value in this extract.

IS_DESIGN_SECTION.name: Design-section flags per section
IS_DESIGN_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags, one per section of the offering, indicating whether each section is a design section. Order corresponds to SECTION_ID.

IS_LAB_SECTION.name: Lab-section flags per section
IS_LAB_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags per section indicating whether each section is a lab section.

IS_LECTURE_SECTION.name: Lecture-section flags per section
IS_LECTURE_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags per section indicating whether each section is a lecture section.

IS_MASTER_SECTION.name: Master-section flags per section
IS_MASTER_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags per section indicating whether each section is the master/primary section of the subject.

IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.name: Offered in fall term
IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the fall term.

IS_OFFERED_IAP.name: Offered in IAP
IS_OFFERED_IAP.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered during Independent Activities Period (January).

IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.name: Offered in spring term
IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the spring term.

IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.name: Offered in summer term
IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the summer term.

IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.name: Offered this year
IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR.description: Y/N flag: subject is offered in the current catalog year.

IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.name: Printed in bulletin
IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN.description: Y/N flag: subject appears in the printed MIT course bulletin.

IS_RECITATION_SECTION.name: Recitation-section flags per section
IS_RECITATION_SECTION.description: Comma-separated Y/N flags per section indicating whether each section is a recitation section.

IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.name: Variable units flag
IS_VARIABLE_UNITS.description: Y/N flag: subject carries a variable number of units (arranged with instructor).

JOINT_SUBJECTS.name: Joint subjects
JOINT_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs with which this subject is jointly listed (the 'J' cross-listing, e.g. '2.689J').

LAB_UNITS.name: Lab units
LAB_UNITS.description: Number of MIT units attributable to laboratory work within TOTAL_UNITS.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Last activity date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the subject record was last updated in the source system, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 16-OCT-08).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: Lecture units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Number of MIT units attributable to lecture within TOTAL_UNITS (MIT unit scheme: 1 lecture unit = 1 hr/week lecture).

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the master subject when this row is a joint/meet-with child; null when the subject is its own master. Related to SO_CLUSTER_TYPE (J/M/S).

MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.name: Meets-with subjects
MEETS_WITH_SUBJECTS.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs with which this subject meets (shared classroom/time) but is not jointly listed.

MEET_PLACE.name: Meeting place(s)
MEET_PLACE.description: MIT building-room location(s) per section, comma-separated in section order (e.g. '5-267E'); 'VIRTUAL' for online offerings.

MEET_TIME.name: Meeting time(s)
MEET_TIME.description: Meeting day/time pattern per section, comma-separated (e.g. 'TR9.30-11' = Tue/Thu 9:30-11), with occasional free-text notes.

ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.name: Online catalog page URL
ON_LINE_PAGE_NUMBER.description: URL of the MIT online catalog page where the subject is listed (http://student.mit.edu/catalog/mXc.html).

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: Preparation units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Number of MIT units attributable to preparation/homework within TOTAL_UNITS.

PREREQUISITES.name: Prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Free-text prerequisite statement: subject IDs, GIR codes (e.g. 'GIR:BIOL'), or notes like 'Permission of instructor'.

PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.name: Print subject ID
PRINT_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID as printed in the bulletin, including the 'J' suffix for joint subjects (e.g. '9.22J'); differs from SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID for joint listings.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: Responsible faculty MIT IDs
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: Comma-separated MIT ID numbers of the responsible faculty member(s), repeated per section. Could join to employee/person tables.

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: Responsible faculty name(s)
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Comma-separated 'Last, First' names of responsible faculty, repeated per section, matching RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.

SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.name: School-wide electives list
SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs that satisfy a school-wide elective requirement this subject belongs to (e.g. engineering school-wide electives). Alternative reading: a list of school-wide elective subjects this subject counts toward; evidence does not distinguish.

SECTION_ID.name: Section IDs
SECTION_ID.description: Comma-separated section identifiers for the offering (L01 = lecture 01, R01 = recitation 01, B01 = lab, 000 = master/registration section). Order matches the per-section Y/N flag columns.

SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.name: Source subject ID
SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID in the source system, without the 'J' joint suffix (e.g. '9.22' where PRINT_SUBJECT_ID is '9.22J').

SO_CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Subject-offering cluster type
SO_CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Type of this subject within a joint/meet-with cluster: J = joint subject, M = master subject, S = (likely) meets-with/secondary subject. S meaning inferred from context.

SO_SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject offering subject ID
SO_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the offering (from SUBJECT_OFFERED); equals SUBJECT_ID/SOURCE_SUBJECT_ID.

SO_TERM_CODE.name: Subject offering term code
SO_TERM_CODE.description: Term code of the offering (e.g. 2011SP, 2007JA = January/IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS(_ALL).TERM_CODE.

SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Subject offering term description
SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable term name matching SO_TERM_CODE (e.g. 'Spring Term 2010-2011', 'January Term 2008-2009').

SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.name: Spring term instructors
SPRING_INSTRUCTORS.description: Instructor names for the spring offering, comma-separated; 'Staff' when unassigned.

STATUS_CHANGE.name: Status change note
STATUS_CHANGE.description: Free-text note on catalog status changes: new subject, removed subject, reinstated, renumbered ('New number: 9.S97', 'Old number: 13.024'), joint-child changes.

SUBJECT_CODE.name: Subject course (department) code
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Department/course number prefix of the subject ID (e.g. '2' in '2.22'). Same as DEPARTMENT_CODE.

SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.name: Subject description
SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: Catalog text description of the subject content.

SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject number, e.g. '2.22', '1.UR'. Key identifying the catalog subject.

SUBJECT_NUMBER.name: Subject number within department
SUBJECT_NUMBER.description: The part of the subject ID after the department code (e.g. '22' for 2.22, 'UR' for 1.UR).

SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.name: Subject short title
SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE.description: Abbreviated title used in schedules (e.g. 'Des Principles: Ocean Vehicles').

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Full catalog title of the subject.

SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.name: Supervisor attribute code
SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.description: Attribute code for supervised-study subjects: UROP = Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program subject, INDP = Independent Study. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.

TERM_DURATION.name: Term duration
TERM_DURATION.description: Portion of the term the subject runs: Full Term, First Half Term, Second Half Term, or Partial Term Subject.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: Total units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (lecture + lab + preparation); 0 for arranged-unit research subjects.

TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.name: Tuition attribute code
TUITION_ATTRIBUTE.description: Special tuition-related attribute: RESH = Pre-thesis Research Subject, NTRN = Internship, COOP = Co-op Subject. References SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE.SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of this extract into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

table.name: DRUPAL_EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY
table.purpose: Employee directory snapshot (one row per employee, keyed by MIT_ID) published for the Drupal MIT website; contains name, contact info, org unit, and employment classification. Appears to be a masked/synthetic version of EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY (emails at worker.com, fake phone numbers).

DIRECTORY_TITLE.name: directory title
DIRECTORY_TITLE.description: Likely the employee's job title as displayed in the Drupal directory listing, possibly differing from PRIMARY_TITLE (e.g. a preferred or display title). Alternative reading: a duplicate of the primary job title; no join evidence distinguishes these.

EMAIL_ADDRESS.name: work email address
EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Employee's email address (masked to @worker.com in this copy). Not unique — shared addresses suggest placeholder/masked values.

EMPLOYEE_GROUP.name: employee group (FLSA classification)
EMPLOYEE_GROUP.description: Employment group: Exempt (7971), Non-Exempt (1999), External (30) — FLSA-style exempt/non-exempt classification plus external affiliates.

EMPLOYEE_TYPE.name: employee type
EMPLOYEE_TYPE.description: HR employment category, e.g. Admin Staff, Sponsored Research Staff, Support Staff, Service Staff, Faculty, Affiliate, Other Academic Group.

FULL_NAME.name: full name
FULL_NAME.description: Full name in 'Last, First [Middle/Initial]' format; near-unique per row.

HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT.name: has additional appointment flag
HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT.description: Y/N flag indicating the employee holds an additional (secondary) appointment; 'Y' for 78 rows.

HAS_DUAL_APPOINTMENT.name: has dual appointment flag
HAS_DUAL_APPOINTMENT.description: Y/N flag indicating a dual appointment; 'Y' for only 3 rows.

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: HR org unit ID
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: Foreign key to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW identifying the employee's organizational unit.

HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE.name: HR org unit title
HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE.description: Name of the employee's organizational unit (e.g. Mechanical Engineering, MIT Health); denormalized from HR_ORG_UNIT.

MIDDLE_NAME.name: middle name or initial
MIDDLE_NAME.description: Middle name or initial; null for ~52% of rows.

MIT_ID.name: MIT ID
MIT_ID.description: Primary key: unique 9-digit MIT person identifier for each employee.

OFFICE_LOCATION.name: office location (building-room)
OFFICE_LOCATION.description: Office location as MIT building-room code (e.g. 37-267F, E15-293, NE49); null for ~10%.

OFFICE_PHONE.name: office phone number
OFFICE_PHONE.description: Office phone number, stored as digits (appears masked/randomized in this copy — values look like synthetic 10-digit numbers, not real MIT extensions).

PERSONAL_URL.name: personal URL
PERSONAL_URL.description: Employee's personal website URL; essentially unused (only 5 non-null values in 10000 rows).

PRIMARY_TITLE.name: primary job title
PRIMARY_TITLE.description: Likely the employee's primary job title. Alternative reading: the title of the primary appointment only (relevant given HAS_ADDL_APPOINTMENT/HAS_DUAL_APPOINTMENT flags); no join evidence distinguishes these.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY
table.purpose: MIT employee/staff directory: one row per employee, with names, department, contact info, office location, and MIT ID. Data appears anonymized/synthetic (fake emails, names, phone numbers).

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the employee's MIT department or lab (e.g., Lincoln Laboratory, Sloan School of Management).

DEPARTMENT_NUMBER.name: department_number
DEPARTMENT_NUMBER.description: Numeric code identifying the employee's department; pairs with DEPARTMENT_NAME (e.g., 310000 = Lincoln Laboratory).

DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME.name: directory_full_name
DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME.description: Employee's full name as displayed in the directory, in 'Last, First M.' format; identical to FULL_NAME.

EMAIL_ADDRESS.name: email_address
EMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Employee's email address (anonymized/synthetic values, e.g., callanr@worker.com).

EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE.name: email_address_uppercase
EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE.description: EMAIL_ADDRESS converted to uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

FULL_NAME.name: full_name
FULL_NAME.description: Employee's full name in 'Last, First M.' format.

FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE.name: full_name_uppercase
FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE.description: FULL_NAME in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

KRB_NAME.name: kerberos_username
KRB_NAME.description: MIT Athena/Kerberos account username (typically firstname+lastname-initial pattern, e.g., callanr).

KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE.name: kerberos_username_uppercase
KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE.description: KRB_NAME in uppercase, for case-insensitive matching.

MIDDLE_NAME.name: middle_name
MIDDLE_NAME.description: Employee's middle name or middle initial; null for about a third of employees.

MIT_ID.name: mit_id
MIT_ID.description: Unique 9-digit MIT identification number for the employee; primary key of the table.

NAME_KNOWN_BY.name: name_known_by
NAME_KNOWN_BY.description: The name the person is known by; in this data identical to FIRST_NAME (likely a preferred display name field).

OFFICE_LOCATION.name: office_location
OFFICE_LOCATION.description: MIT building-room office location code (e.g., 8-479 = building 8 room 479; LL- prefixed codes are Lincoln Laboratory).

OFFICE_PHONE.name: office_phone
OFFICE_PHONE.description: Office phone number stored as digits (anonymized/synthetic values; real MIT numbers would be 617/xxx exchanges).

PERSONAL_URL.name: personal_url
PERSONAL_URL.description: Employee's personal/homepage URL; populated for only ~14% of rows.

PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME.name: preferred_first_name
PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME.description: Preferred first name; identical to FIRST_NAME in this data.

PREFERRED_LAST_NAME.name: preferred_last_name
PREFERRED_LAST_NAME.description: Preferred last name; identical to LAST_NAME in this data.

PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME.name: preferred_middle_name
PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME.description: Preferred middle name/initial; null for ~69% of rows, otherwise matches MIDDLE_NAME.

table.name: ESTIMATED_SURCHARGES_ESTONLY
table.purpose: Unresolved. The table is empty (0 rows), so no data evidence exists. The name and column names suggest a financial fact table of estimated surcharges (e.g., F&A/administrative charge estimates) keyed by cost collector, GL account, and month, with budget and commitment amounts — but this is inferred from names alone, not data. The suffix ESTONLY may mean 'estimates only'. No joins to other tables were detected, so relationships to TIME_MONTH, FRC_FISCAL_PERIODS, etc. cannot be confirmed.

table.name: FAC_BUILDING
table.purpose: Facilities building inventory: one row per MIT building (242 buildings), with name, type/use, areas, room counts, location coordinates, dates, ownership, and parent-building relationships. Referenced by floor, room, and address tables; mirrors FCLT_BUILDING/BUILDINGS.

ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE.name: Access level code
ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE.description: Numeric access/security level of the building (0, 1, or 2); 2 is most common (185 of 242). Exact meaning of each level is not defined by the data.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Assignable floor area (sq ft)
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable square footage of the building (rooms assignable to occupants/programs); 0 for buildings not yet measured. Consistent with MIT space-audit conventions (assignable + non-assignable <= external gross area).

BUILDING_HEIGHT.name: Building height (ft)
BUILDING_HEIGHT.description: Height of the building in feet (values 0 to 275, e.g. 275 for Green Building-scale towers); 0 or null when unknown/not applicable.

BUILDING_NAME.name: Building name (short/uppercase)
BUILDING_NAME.description: Official short building name in uppercase (e.g. 'COGENERATION PLANT', 'MIT ALUMNI POOL'); not unique (7 rows share 'WALLACE ASTROPHYSICAL OBSERVATORY').

BUILDING_NAMED_FOR.name: Person(s) building is named for
BUILDING_NAMED_FOR.description: Names of honorees the building is named after (e.g. 'CHARLES HAYDEN', 'ALFRED P. SLOAN JR.'); '-' indicates not named for a person.

BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Building long name
BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Full/mixed-case building name (e.g. 'Ray and Maria Stata Center', 'William R. Dickson Cogeneration Plant'); nearly unique, parallels BUILDING_NAME.

BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Building number
BUILDING_NUMBER.description: MIT building number/code, unique per row (e.g. '42', 'E66', 'W85A', 'OC19Q'); primary identifier referenced by address, floor, room, and history tables.

BUILDING_SORT.name: Building sort key
BUILDING_SORT.description: Zero-padded/normalized version of the building number used for sorting (e.g. '01', '02'); one-to-one with BUILDING_NUMBER.

BUILDING_TYPE.name: Building type
BUILDING_TYPE.description: Broad classification: ACADEMIC (126), SERVICE (59), or RESIDENT (57).

BUILDING_USE.name: Building use code
BUILDING_USE.description: Use code: AER (academic/research, 124), DHOA (dormitory/house, 54), OTH (other, 32), STAC (student activities/athletic, 17), GAR (garage/parking), plus '(NULL)' literal for 8 rows. Exact code expansions are inferred from context, not documented.

CAMPUS_SECTOR.name: Campus sector
CAMPUS_SECTOR.description: Campus region: WEST, MAIN GROUP, OFFCAMPUS, EAST, NORTHWEST, NORTHEAST, and variants like 'WESTWEST' (likely data-entry variant of WEST).

COST_CENTER_CODE.name: Cost center code
COST_CENTER_CODE.description: SAP-style cost center number (7-digit, e.g. 1814200) for the building's financial accounting; null for ~46% of buildings (leased/unassigned).

COST_COLLECTOR_KEY.name: Cost collector key
COST_COLLECTOR_KEY.description: Identical values to COST_CENTER_CODE in every statistic and sample; appears to be a duplicate/alias column of the cost center. Whether it is semantically distinct in source systems cannot be determined from this table.

DATE_ACQUIRED.name: Date acquired
DATE_ACQUIRED.description: Date MIT acquired the building (MM/DD/YYYY), mostly for leased/off-campus properties; 88% null.

DATE_BUILT.name: Date built
DATE_BUILT.description: Construction/completion date of the building (MM/DD/YYYY); 38% null.

DATE_OCCUPIED.name: Date occupied
DATE_OCCUPIED.description: Date the building was first occupied (MM/DD/YYYY); 26% null.

EASTING_X_SPCS.name: Easting coordinate (SPCS)
EASTING_X_SPCS.description: X/easting coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (Massachusetts Mainland, US survey feet, ~760,000 range); null for off-campus/leased sites.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: External gross area (sq ft)
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: External gross square footage of the building (includes walls, circulation); largest area measure, 0 for unmeasured buildings.

FAC_BUILDING_KEY.name: Facilities building key
FAC_BUILDING_KEY.description: Primary key of this table; equals BUILDING_NUMBER in all samples ('42', 'E66'). Referenced by FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS, FAC_FLOOR, FAC_ROOMS and the FCLT_* history tables.

LATITUDE_WGS.name: Latitude (WGS84)
LATITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 latitude of the building (~42.25-42.62, centered on Cambridge campus); null for ~43% of rows.

LONGITUDE_WGS.name: Longitude (WGS84)
LONGITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 longitude of the building (~-71.49 to -70.98, centered on Cambridge campus); null for ~43% of rows.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Non-assignable area (sq ft)
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable square footage (corridors, mechanical, restrooms, etc.); 0 for unmeasured buildings.

NORTHING_Y_SPCS.name: Northing coordinate (SPCS)
NORTHING_Y_SPCS.description: Y/northing coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (~2.95M ft range for the Cambridge area); null for off-campus/leased sites.

NUM_OF_ROOMS.name: Number of rooms
NUM_OF_ROOMS.description: Count of rooms in the building (0 to 1424).

OCCUPANCY_CLASS.name: Occupancy class code
OCCUPANCY_CLASS.description: Building/fire-code occupancy classification (codes like UGB, UGR2, UGBA3, UGF1, UGA1A3BH - likely unbonded/unsprinklered business, group-residential, business-assembly mixes per MA building code); '(NULL)' literal for 98 rows. Exact code meanings not documented here.

OWNERSHIP_TYPE.name: Ownership type
OWNERSHIP_TYPE.description: Whether the building is OWNED (220) or LEASED (22).

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.name: Parent building name (uppercase)
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.description: Uppercase name of the parent building for sub-buildings/annexes (e.g. 'MACGREGOR HOUSE'); null for 87% of rows (standalone buildings).

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Parent building long name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Mixed-case long name of the parent building (e.g. 'Frank S MacGregor House'); null for standalone buildings.

PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Parent building number
PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.description: Building number of the parent building (references BUILDING_NUMBER), e.g. 'W61' for MacGregor entries; null for standalone buildings.

SITE.name: Site code
SITE.description: Site/campus location code: MIT (main campus, 198), BATES (Bates Linear Accelerator, 14), HAY (Haystack Observatory, 12), LINC (Lincoln Laboratory, 9), BOS (Boston), END (Endicott House), etc.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all 242 rows (full snapshot load).

table.name: FAC_BUILDING_ADDRESS
table.purpose: Street/mailing/E911 addresses for MIT campus buildings; one row per building per address purpose (street, mail, parcel, E911). References FAC_BUILDING/FCLT_BUILDING/BUILDINGS by building key; history kept in FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_HIST.

ADDRESS_CITY_ID.name: Address city ID
ADDRESS_CITY_ID.description: Numeric identifier for the city/town of the address, apparently a city code (e.g. 708 = Cambridge). Not joined to any table here, so the exact code system is unresolved; another reading is that it is an internal warehouse surrogate for CITY.

ADDRESS_PURPOSE.name: Address purpose
ADDRESS_PURPOSE.description: Type of address: STREET (primary street address), MAIL (mailing address), PARCL1/PARCL2 (parcel addresses), E911_1..E911_6 (emergency-911 registered addresses).

BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY.name: Building address key
BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY.description: Primary key, formed as BUILDING_KEY + '-' + ADDRESS_PURPOSE (e.g. 'N16-E911_1'). Referenced by FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS_HIST.

BUILDING_KEY.name: Building key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Foreign key to FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING / BUILDINGS; MIT building number code such as 'W70', 'N16', '2'.

CITY.name: City
CITY.description: City or town of the address (mostly CAMBRIDGE, plus Middleton, Westford, Lexington, Boston, Washington DC, etc.).

IS_E911_ADDRESS.name: Is E911 address
IS_E911_ADDRESS.description: Likely a yes/no flag indicating whether this row is an emergency-911 registered address, consistent with the E911_1..E911_6 values of ADDRESS_PURPOSE; no join evidence confirms this, so it could alternatively mark the primary E911 address among several.

POSTAL_CODE.name: ZIP code
POSTAL_CODE.description: US ZIP code stored without leading zero (2139 = 02139, 2142 = 02142, 20002 = Washington DC).

POST_DIRECTIONAL.name: Post-directional
POST_DIRECTIONAL.description: Directional or qualifier after the street name (NE, NW, '(Rear)').

STATE.name: State
STATE.description: Two-letter state code: MA for nearly all rows, DC for the Washington DC address.

STREET_NAME.name: Street name
STREET_NAME.description: Street name without number or suffix (MASSACHUSETTS = Massachusetts Ave, MEMORIAL = Memorial Drive, VASSAR, ALBANY, AMES, etc.).

STREET_NUMBER.name: Street number
STREET_NUMBER.description: House/street number; mostly numeric ('77', '182') but some coded values like 'MEM106'/'MEM311' (Memorial Drive numbering).

STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX.name: Street number suffix
STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX.description: Suffix appended to the street number; only value observed is 'R' (Rear), matching the '(Rear)' post-directional rows.

STREET_SUFFIX.name: Street suffix
STREET_SUFFIX.description: Street type abbreviation: ST, AVE, DR, RD, SQ, CIR, etc.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (single full load).

table.name: FAC_FLOOR
table.purpose: Facilities floor inventory: one row per floor of each campus building, with floor-level area measurements (assignable, non-assignable, exterior gross) and access classification. Referenced by room-level tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: access_level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Access classification code for the floor, 0-3; 2 is by far the most common. Exact meaning of each level (e.g., public vs. restricted) is not evidenced.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: assignable_area_sqft
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable (usable/occupiable) floor area, in square feet; 0 for floors with no assignable space.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Building identifier (MIT-style building number, e.g. E37, W84, 54); references FAC_BUILDING / FCLT_BUILDING / BUILDINGS.

BUILDING_WINGS_ID.name: building_wings_id
BUILDING_WINGS_ID.description: Wing identifiers for the floor, formatted as building.wing (e.g. W61A.1); mostly null, sometimes a space-separated list of multiple wings. Only populated for winged buildings like W61.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: ext_gross_area_sqft
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: Exterior gross floor area, in square feet (includes exterior wall thickness; larger than assignable + non-assignable in general).

FLOOR.name: floor_number
FLOOR.description: Floor label within the building: numeric floors 0-30 plus basement/sublevel codes like 'D6', '00'.

FLOOR_KEY.name: floor_key
FLOOR_KEY.description: Primary key: building_key + '-' + floor label (e.g. E19-2); one-to-one with FCLT_FLOOR and referenced by room tables.

FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.name: floor_sort_sequence
FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.description: Numeric sort order for floors, using negative values for basement/sublevels (e.g. -2) so they sort below floor 0.

LEVEL_ID.name: level_id
LEVEL_ID.description: Numeric level identifier, negative for sublevels; similar to FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE but null for ~11% of rows. Exact distinction from FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE is not evidenced.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: non_assignable_area_sqft
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area (circulation, mechanical, restrooms, etc.), in square feet.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: FAC_MAJOR_USE
table.purpose: Lookup table of facility space major-use categories (e.g., classrooms, laboratories, circulation, residential) used to classify rooms in facility/space data. Each row is one major-use category with a numeric key, an 8-character code, a description, and a flag indicating whether the space is assignable. Referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST) and a history table (FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST).

ASSIGNABLE.name: Assignable space flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: 1 if space in this major-use category is assignable (e.g., classrooms, laboratories, general use); 0 if non-assignable (e.g., circulation, mechanical, building service areas).

DESCRIPTION.name: Major use description
DESCRIPTION.description: Full-text description of the major-use category (e.g., 'CLASSROOMS', 'CIRCULATION AREA', 'MECHANICAL AREA').

MAJOR_USE.name: Major use code
MAJOR_USE.description: Short 8-character code for the major-use category (e.g., CLASSRMS, CIRCULAT, MECHANIC, RESIDENT, UNCLASS). Joins one-to-one to FCLT_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE and is referenced by room tables as MAJOR_USE_DESC.

MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: Major use key
MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Primary key; numeric surrogate key (101-114) identifying each major-use category. Referenced by FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, and FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows show 19-DEC-24), i.e., an ETL load timestamp.

table.name: FAC_ORGANIZATION
table.purpose: Current reference/dimension table of MIT facility-space organizations (departments, labs, centers) used for space and room assignment. One row per organization, with its code, name, hierarchy (parent, level, major org), HR department cross-references, and D-code links to the department hierarchy. Referenced by room tables (FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS) and mirrored by FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST. 169 rows, snapshot loaded 19-DEC-24.

ASSIGNABLE.name: is_space_assignable
ASSIGNABLE.description: Flag (0/1) indicating whether the organization can be assigned space/rooms; 1 for 166 of 169 orgs.

COURSE.name: course_number
COURSE.description: Course/subject number associated with the organization (e.g. '21F', '17', 'STS'); null for ~81% of rows (non-academic units). Exact semantics (which catalog) unresolved.

DESCRIPTION.name: full_description
DESCRIPTION.description: Long-form description of the organization (e.g. 'Dept of Earth, Atmospheric, & Planetary Sciences'); null for ~61% of rows.

D_CODE.name: d_code
D_CODE.description: Department DLC code (e.g. D_MECHE, D_DEANSCI) linking to the master department hierarchy (MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT / MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY).

HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.name: hr_department_code_old
HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.description: Old HR department number (e.g. 310000 Lincoln Laboratory); matches ORGANIZATION_NUMBER in most rows. Links to SPACE_UNIT.

HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: hr_department_name
HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: HR system name of the department (e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory', 'Research Administration Services').

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: hr_org_unit_id
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: HR organizational unit identifier (10000xxx), foreign key to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

MAJOR_ORG.name: major_org_code
MAJOR_ORG.description: Code of the top-level executive area the org reports to (PROVST=Provost, CHNCLR=Chancellor, EXECVP=Executive VP, PRES=President, VP-SCP, ZORG, ALL).

MAJOR_ORG_KEY.name: major_org_key
MAJOR_ORG_KEY.description: Numeric key of the major organization (e.g. 230=PROVST, 129=CHNCLR, 163=EXECVP); references FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.

ORGANIZATION.name: organization_code
ORGANIZATION.description: Unique short organization code (e.g. LINCLB, RAS, AERO); referenced by room and facility-org tables as the org identifier.

ORGANIZATION_ID.name: organization_id
ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Unique numeric ID of the organization; identical values to ORGANIZATION_KEY (duplicate column).

ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: organization_key
ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Primary key: unique numeric key (101-288) of the organization; referenced by FAC_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ORGANIZATION, SPACE_UNIT, etc.

ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.name: hierarchy_level
ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.description: Depth of the org in the hierarchy, 1 (top, e.g. ALL/PRES) to 6; most orgs are at level 5.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: organization_name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Unique uppercase display name of the organization (e.g. 'LINCOLN LAB', 'RSCH ADMIN SERVICES').

ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.name: organization_number
