ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.description: HR-style department number for the org (e.g. 310000); largely duplicates HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.

BUILDING_USE.name: Building use code

DATE_BUILT.name: Date built

DATE_OCCUPIED.name: Date occupied

EASTING_X_SPCS.name: Easting (X) coordinate, State Plane Coordinate System

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: External gross area (sq ft)
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: External gross floor area of the building in square feet (largest of the area measures).

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: Facilities building key

LATITUDE_WGS.name: Latitude (WGS84)

LONGITUDE_WGS.name: Longitude (WGS84)
LONGITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 longitude of the building (values around -71.09 = Cambridge, MA); null for some sites.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Non-assignable area (sq ft)
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area (circulation, mechanical, etc.) in square feet; 0 for buildings with no rooms.

NORTHING_Y_SPCS.name: Northing (Y) coordinate, State Plane Coordinate System
NORTHING_Y_SPCS.description: Y (northing) coordinate of the building in the State Plane Coordinate System (feet); null for off-campus/leased sites.

NUM_OF_ROOMS.name: Number of rooms
NUM_OF_ROOMS.description: Count of rooms in the building (0 to 1424).

OCCUPANCY_CLASS.name: Occupancy class code
OCCUPANCY_CLASS.description: Building/fire-code occupancy classification code (e.g. UGB, UGR2, UGA3, UGF1 — likely 'Unprotected' business/group codes); '(NULL)' placeholder when unknown. PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.name: Parent building name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.description: Short name of the parent building for sub-buildings/annexes (e.g. 'MACGREGOR HOUSE'); null for standalone buildings.

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Parent building long name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Long display name of the parent building (e.g. 'Frank S MacGregor House'); null for standalone buildings.

PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Parent building number
PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.description: Building number of the parent building (references BUILDING_NUMBER); null for standalone buildings.

SITE.name: Site code

POST_DIRECTIONAL.name: post_directional

STREET_NAME.description: Street name of the address (MASSACHUSETTS, MEMORIAL, VASSAR, ALBANY, AMES, etc.).

BUILDING_NAME.description: Official uppercase building name, e.g. 'WALLACE ASTROPHYSICAL OBSERVATORY', 'BUILDING 24'.

BUILDING_NAMED_FOR.name: Building named for
BUILDING_NAMED_FOR.description: Person(s) the building is named after ('CHARLES HAYDEN', 'ALFRED P. SLOAN JR.'); '-' means not named for anyone.

BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Building long name
BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Mixed-case long/mixed-case display name of the building, e.g. 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'.

BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Building number
BUILDING_NUMBER.description: MIT building number/code (e.g. '10', 'W61H', 'OC19Q'), the natural key of the building; references FCLT_BUILDING/FAC_BUILDING.

BUILDING_SORT.name: Building sort key
BUILDING_SORT.description: Zero-padded building number used for sorting (e.g. '06B'); same building identity as BUILDING_NUMBER.

BUILDING_TYPE.name: Building type
BUILDING_TYPE.description: Broad building category: ACADEMIC, RESIDENT (dorms), or SERVICE (garages, plants, support).

BUILDING_USE.name: Building use code
BUILDING_USE.description: Use code: AER (academic/research), DHOA (dormitory), GAR (garage), STAC (stacks/library?), OTH (other), (NULL). Exact expansion of STAC is tentative.

CAMPUS_SECTOR.name: Campus sector
CAMPUS_SECTOR.description: Campus region: WEST, EAST, MAIN GROUP, NORTHWEST, OFFCAMPUS, etc. Some values appear doubled ('WESTWEST','EASTEAST'), likely a data-quality artifact.

COST_CENTER_CODE.name: Cost center code
COST_CENTER_CODE.description: SAP-style cost center number (7-digit, e.g. 1839100) responsible for the building; null for many (e.g. dorms).

COST_COLLECTOR_KEY.name: Cost collector key
COST_COLLECTOR_KEY.description: Duplicate of COST_CENTER_CODE (identical values); likely a join key to a cost-collecting entity, but here it mirrors the cost center.

DATE_ACQUIRED.name: Date acquired
DATE_ACQUIRED.description: Date MIT acquired the building (DD-MON-YY); null for 87% of rows (mostly owned-from-construction).

DATE_BUILT.name: Date built
DATE_BUILT.description: Construction/completion date of the building (DD-MON-YY); placeholder values like 31-DEC-xx are common.

DATE_OCCUPIED.name: Date occupied
DATE_OCCUPIED.description: Date the building was first occupied (DD-MON-YY).

EASTING_X_SPCS.name: Easting (state plane coordinate, ft)
EASTING_X_SPCS.description: X coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (feet, ~766,000 for Cambridge MA); the 922.337 values are placeholder/invalid.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: External gross area (sq ft)
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: Exterior gross floor area of the building in square feet (includes walls, garages).

FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY.name: History key
FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key of this history table: building number + fiscal period, e.g. 'W91-201508'; one-to-one with FCLT_BUILDING_HIST.

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: Building key
FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.description: Foreign key to FCLT_BUILDING (the building's number/code), identifying which building this snapshot row describes.

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: Fiscal period (YYYYMM)
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal month of the snapshot in YYYYMM form (201505-201906); references TIME_MONTH.

LATITUDE_WGS.name: Latitude (WGS84)
LATITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 latitude of the building (~42.36 for Cambridge MA); null when geocode unavailable.

LONGITUDE_WGS.name: Longitude (WGS84)
LONGITUDE_WGS.description: WGS84 longitude of the building (~-71.09 for Cambridge MA).

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Non-assignable area (sq ft)
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area (circulation, mechanical, restrooms) in square feet.

NORTHING_Y_SPCS.name: Northing (state plane coordinate, ft)
NORTHING_Y_SPCS.description: Y coordinate in the State Plane Coordinate System (feet, ~2,956,000 for Cambridge MA); 922.337 is a placeholder.

NUM_OF_ROOMS.name: Number of rooms
NUM_OF_ROOMS.description: Count of rooms in the building (0 to 1410).

OCCUPANCY_CLASS.name: Occupancy class code
OCCUPANCY_CLASS.description: Building-code style occupancy classification (UGB business, UGR2 residential, UGBA3/UGA3 assembly, etc.); '(NULL)' string means unclassified. Exact code taxonomy unresolved.

OWNERSHIP_TYPE.name: Ownership type
OWNERSHIP_TYPE.description: Whether the building is OWNED by MIT or LEASED.

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.name: Parent building name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME.description: Uppercase name of the parent building for wings/sub-buildings (e.g. MACGREGOR HOUSE for W61H); null for standalone buildings.

PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.name: Parent building long name
PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG.description: Mixed-case long name of the parent building; null for standalone buildings.

PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.name: Parent building number
PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER.description: Building number of the parent building (e.g. 'W61' for W61H); references FCLT_BUILDING/FAC_BUILDING/BUILDINGS.

SITE.name: Site code
SITE.description: Site/location code: MIT (main campus), BATES (Bates Linac), LINC (Lincoln Lab), HAY (Haystack Observatory), BOS (Boston), END (Endicott House).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (DD-MON-YY), typically the 1st of the month following the fiscal period.

table.name: FCLT_FLOOR
table.purpose: Facilities floor inventory: one row per floor (or floor-like level) of each campus building, with floor areas and access classification. Referenced by room-level tables (FCLT_ROOMS, FAC_ROOMS) and a history table (FCLT_FLOOR_HIST).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: Access level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded access/security classification of the floor (0-3). Values 0-3 with 2 dominant; exact code meanings are not defined in this table, so the specific labels are unresolved.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Assignable area (sq ft)
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable floor area in square feet (rooms usable for occupancy, excluding circulation/mechanical). Zero for 117 floors.

BUILDING_WINGS_ID.name: Building wings ID
BUILDING_WINGS_ID.description: Identifier(s) of the building wing(s) this floor record covers; only populated for ~1.4% of rows, mostly building W61. Format like 'W61A.1' (wing.floor) and can list multiple wings. Exact semantics beyond wing identification are unresolved.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: External gross area (sq ft)
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: External gross floor area in square feet (total constructed floor area including exterior walls).

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: Building key
FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.description: Building number/code (e.g. E19, W20, 45) identifying the building this floor belongs to; references FCLT_BUILDING / FAC_BUILDING.

FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.name: Floor key
FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.description: Primary key: building number plus floor number, e.g. 'E19-2', 'W1-7'. Referenced by room tables and floor history.

FLOOR.name: Floor number
FLOOR.description: Floor identifier within the building; mostly numeric (0-30) but includes non-numeric codes like 'D6' (likely basement/sub-level designations).

FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.name: Floor sort sequence
FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.description: Numeric sort order for floors, using negative values for below-ground levels (e.g. -2, -3) so basements sort before floor 0.

LEVEL_ID.name: Level ID
LEVEL_ID.description: Numeric level identifier, negative for below-ground levels; similar to FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE but null for ~11% of rows. Relationship to FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE (why it differs/is null) is unresolved.

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: Non-assignable area (sq ft)
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area in square feet (circulation, mechanical, restrooms, etc.).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

table.name: FCLT_FLOOR_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly (fiscal-period) snapshot history of facility floor records: one row per building floor per fiscal period, tracking floor areas, access level, and wing assignments over time. Companion history table to FCLT_FLOOR in a facilities/space data warehouse (MIT-style building numbers like W61, E55).

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: ACCESS_LEVEL
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded access/security classification of the floor (0-3), predominantly 2; mirrors the access classification on FCLT_FLOOR. Exact meaning of each code is not derivable from this table alone, so the specific level definitions remain tentative.

ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: ASSIGNABLE_AREA
ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Assignable floor area in square feet (rooms assignable to occupants/programs); 0 for floors with no assignable space.

BUILDING_WINGS_ID.name: BUILDING_WINGS_ID
BUILDING_WINGS_ID.description: Identifier(s) of building wing(s) the floor belongs to (e.g. W61A.1); mostly null; can hold multiple space-separated wing IDs.

EXT_GROSS_AREA.name: EXT_GROSS_AREA
EXT_GROSS_AREA.description: External gross area of the floor in square feet (total floor area including non-assignable space; equals assignable + non-assignable in samples).

FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.name: FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
FCLT_BUILDING_KEY.description: Building identifier (building number, e.g. W61A, E55); references FCLT_BUILDING.

FCLT_FLOOR_HIST_KEY.name: FCLT_FLOOR_HIST_KEY
FCLT_FLOOR_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key: composite of building key, floor/level, and fiscal period (e.g. W61A-2-201505).

FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.name: FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
FCLT_FLOOR_KEY.description: Floor identifier: building key plus floor number (e.g. W61A-2); references FCLT_FLOOR / FAC_FLOOR.

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: FISCAL_PERIOD
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal period (year-month, e.g. 201505) of the snapshot; references TIME_MONTH.

FLOOR.name: FLOOR
FLOOR.description: Floor number/label within the building (0-30, with some non-numeric labels like 'D6', '00').

FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.name: FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE
FLOOR_SORT_SEQUENCE.description: Numeric sort order for the floor label, allowing basement/sub-level floors to sort below ground (negative values).

LEVEL_ID.name: LEVEL_ID
LEVEL_ID.description: Numeric level identifier within the building, essentially the floor number normalized for sorting (negatives for basements).

NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.name: NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
NON_ASSIGNABLE_AREA.description: Non-assignable floor area in square feet (circulation, mechanical, restrooms, etc.).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the warehouse (first of month, e.g. 01-DEC-14), one per fiscal period snapshot.

table.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE
table.purpose: Lookup table of facility space major-use categories (classrooms, labs, circulation, mechanical, etc.) used to classify rooms in MIT facility/space data. Referenced by room tables (FCLT_ROOMS, FAC_ROOMS) and a history table. 14 rows, one per use category.

ASSIGNABLE.name: Assignable flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Whether space in this major-use category is assignable/assignable-to-use space (1) or non-assignable (0), e.g. circulation and mechanical areas are 0, classrooms/general use are 1.

DESCRIPTION.name: Major use description
DESCRIPTION.description: Full text description of the space major-use category, e.g. 'CLASSROOMS', 'CIRCULATION AREA', 'MECHANICAL AREA'.

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: Major use key
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Primary key; numeric surrogate key (101-114) for the major-use category, referenced by FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST and FAC_ROOMS.

MAJOR_USE.name: Major use code
MAJOR_USE.description: Short 8-character code for the major-use category (e.g. 'CLASSRMS', 'CIRCULAT', 'MECHANIC'), matching FAC_MAJOR_USE and used as MAJOR_USE_DESC in room tables.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (all rows 19-DEC-24); an ETL load timestamp, not a business date.

table.name: FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST
table.purpose: History table of facility space major-use category definitions, one row per major-use code per fiscal period, tracking whether each use category is assignable space and how it is described over time. It is the historical (point-in-time) version of FCLT_MAJOR_USE, a lookup of space use classifications (classrooms, laboratories, circulation, mechanical, residential, etc.).

ASSIGNABLE.name: Assignable space flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Flag indicating whether space in this major-use category is considered assignable (1) or non-assignable (0). About 79% of rows are assignable (e.g., classrooms, laboratories); non-assignable ones include circulation, building service, and mechanical areas.

DESCRIPTION.name: Major use description
DESCRIPTION.description: Full description of the space major-use category (e.g., 'CLASSROOMS', 'CIRCULATION AREA', 'MECHANICAL AREA', 'RESIDENTIAL', 'UNCLASSIFIED', 'ZUSE ICR ONLY').

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST_KEY.name: History record key
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key of the history table: concatenation of the major-use key and the fiscal period (e.g., '114-202211'), uniquely identifying a major-use category's state in a given fiscal period.

FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.name: Major use key
FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY.description: Numeric key (101-114) of the space major-use category; references FCLT_MAJOR_USE.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY (and equivalently FAC_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE_KEY).

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: Fiscal period
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal year and month as YYYYMM (e.g., 202307 = July 2023, the start of MIT's fiscal year); references TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD. Identifies the point in time each major-use definition applies.

MAJOR_USE.name: Major use code
MAJOR_USE.description: Short 8-character code for the space major-use category (e.g., 'CLASSRMS', 'CIRCULAT', 'MECHANIC', 'RESIDENT', 'UNCLASS', 'ZUSE'); references FAC_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE and FCLT_MAJOR_USE.MAJOR_USE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY format) the row was loaded into the data warehouse; typically the 1st of a month, roughly one month after the fiscal period it represents.

table.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION
table.purpose: Facilities (FCLT) dimension of MIT organizational units/departments: one row per DLC/department-level organization with its hierarchy, HR department codes, and facility-related attributes. It is the facilities-side counterpart of FAC_ORGANIZATION, with a companion history table FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST and a DLC crosswalk FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY. Used to attribute space/rooms (FCLT_ROOMS etc.) to owning organizations.

ASSIGNABLE.name: Assignable flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Boolean flag (0/1) indicating whether the organization's space is assignable (e.g., assignable square footage / assignable to the org). 175 of 180 rows are 1; exact semantics (assignable space vs. org eligible for space assignment) is not fully determinable.

COURSE.name: Course number prefix
COURSE.description: MIT course/subject number prefix for academic departments (e.g. 21L = Literature, 21F, STS = Science, Technology and Society). Null for non-academic administrative units (82% null).

DESCRIPTION.name: Organization description
DESCRIPTION.description: Longer descriptive name of the unit (e.g. 'Dept of Earth, Atmospheric, & Planetary Sciences', 'Center for International Studies'). Null in ~63% of rows.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC key
DLC_KEY.description: Department-Lab-Center (DLC) code prefixed with 'D_' (e.g. D_LIT, D_EAPS), joining to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY. D_FACILITIES appears 11 times (multiple facilities orgs share one DLC).

DLC_NAME.name: DLC name
DLC_NAME.description: Full name of the Department-Lab-Center corresponding to DLC_KEY (e.g. 'Department of Facilities', 'Literature').

FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.name: Major organization key
FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.description: Surrogate key of the top-level major organization (e.g. 230 = Provost, 129 = Chancellor, 163 = Executive VP) this unit rolls up to; references FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_KEY.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: Organization key (primary key)
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Primary key of this table; surrogate key for the organization unit, matching ORGANIZATION_ID values (e.g. 176, 193).

FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.name: Parent organization key
FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.description: Surrogate key of the parent organization in the facilities org hierarchy (self-referencing to FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY / FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_KEY). Null for top-level units.

HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.name: HR department code (old)
HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.description: Legacy HR department number (e.g. 591040 Dining, 93600 Literature Section); largely matches ORGANIZATION_NUMBER and joins to SPACE_UNIT codes.

HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: HR department name
HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: HR system name of the department (e.g. 'Literature Section', 'MIT Sea Grant College Program').

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: HR org unit ID
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: HR organizational unit identifier (~10000xxx), joining to HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

MAJOR_ORG.name: Major organization code
MAJOR_ORG.description: Code of the top-level executive area the unit belongs to: PROVST (Provost), CHNCLR (Chancellor), EXECVP (Executive VP), PRES (President), ZORG, OTHMIT, ALL, VP-SCP etc.

ORGANIZATION.name: Organization code
ORGANIZATION.description: Short organization code (e.g. LIT, AERO, MECH, DOFADM), unique per row; joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

ORGANIZATION_ID.name: Organization ID
ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Numeric organization identifier, same values as FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY (e.g. 176, 193); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION and FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.

ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.name: Hierarchy level
ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.description: Depth of the unit in the organization hierarchy, 1 (top, e.g. ALL/PRES) to 6; most units are at level 5.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: Organization name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Uppercase organization name (e.g. 'LITERATURE', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE'); joins to FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.name: Organization number
ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.description: HR department number for the unit (e.g. 93600 Literature, 68200 Singapore/MIT Alliance); nearly identical to HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD; joins to SPACE_UNIT.

ORGANIZATION_SORT.name: Sort key
ORGANIZATION_SORT.description: Numeric sort key (~101xxxxxx) used to order organizations hierarchically for display/reporting; appears to encode major org and level ordering. No join evidence is available to confirm whether it is purely a display sort key or encodes a structural identifier.

ORG_PARENT.name: Parent organization code
ORG_PARENT.description: Code of the parent organization (e.g. 'S H&SS' = School of Humanities Arts & Social Sciences, 'EXECVP', 'S ENG' = School of Engineering); corresponds to FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows (full snapshot load).

table.name: FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST
table.purpose: Monthly (fiscal-period) snapshot history of MIT facility/organization hierarchy records: one row per organization per fiscal period, tracking each org's code, name, parent, DLC (department/lab/center) mapping, HR department linkage, and whether it is space-assignable. Companion history table to FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FAC_ORGANIZATION.

ASSIGNABLE.name: assignable_flag
ASSIGNABLE.description: Flag (0/1) indicating whether the organization is assignable, i.e. whether space/rooms can be assigned to this organization (1 = assignable, ~97.5% of rows).

DESCRIPTION.name: organization_long_description
DESCRIPTION.description: Long-form description of the organization, populated only for a handful of interdisciplinary centers/offices (IMES, LGO, IDSS, etc.); null for most rows.

DLC_KEY.name: dlc_key
DLC_KEY.description: Key of the DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) associated with the organization, prefixed 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_FACILITIES = Department of Facilities). References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY.

DLC_NAME.name: dlc_name
DLC_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) associated with the organization (e.g. 'Department of Facilities', 'Provost's Office').

FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.name: major_organization_key
FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY.description: Key of the top-level/major organization the org rolls up to; values are either numeric org keys ('230', '129') or executive codes ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR', 'EXECVP', 'PRES', 'ALL').

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST_KEY.name: organization_history_key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST_KEY.description: Primary key of the history table: composite of organization key and fiscal period (e.g. '150-202010').

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: organization_key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Surrogate key of the organization (same value as ORGANIZATION_ID); references FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FAC_ORGANIZATION.

FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.name: parent_organization_key
FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY.description: Key of the parent organization in the facility org hierarchy (e.g. 230 = School of Engineering as parent of 243).

FISCAL_PERIOD.name: fiscal_period
FISCAL_PERIOD.description: Fiscal period (year+month, e.g. 201510) of the snapshot; references TIME_MONTH.FISCAL_PERIOD.

HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.name: hr_department_code_old
HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD.description: Old HR department code (6-digit, e.g. 591040) for the organization; matches ORGANIZATION_NUMBER in most rows and joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE.

HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: hr_department_name
HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: HR department name for the organization (e.g. 'Dining', 'School of Humanities, Arts, & Social Sci').

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: hr_org_unit_id
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: HR organizational unit identifier (e.g. 10000653); references HR_ORG_UNIT / HR_ORG_UNIT_NEW.

MAJOR_ORG.name: major_organization_code
MAJOR_ORG.description: Code of the major (top-level) organization the org belongs to; mostly executive codes (PROVST, CHNCLR, EXECVP, ZORG, OTHMIT) but sometimes numeric HR dept codes — mixed representation, likely the label form of FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY. Alternative reading: a free-form rollup label rather than a strict code, given the mixed values.

ORGANIZATION.name: organization_code
ORGANIZATION.description: Short organization code (e.g. 'DOFADM' = Dept of Facilities Admin, 'S ENG' = School of Engineering, 'AERO'); references FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

ORGANIZATION_ID.name: organization_id
ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Numeric organization identifier (101–277), identical to FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY; references FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_ID.

ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.name: organization_hierarchy_level
ORGANIZATION_LEVEL.description: Level of the org in the hierarchy tree, 1 (top, e.g. MIT president) to 6 (leaf departments); most rows are level 5.

ORGANIZATION_NAME.name: organization_short_name
ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: Abbreviated organization name (e.g. 'SCH OF ENGINEER', 'DP OF FACIL ADM'); references FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.name: organization_number
ORGANIZATION_NUMBER.description: HR/department number of the organization (mostly 6-digit codes like 591040, matching HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD; a few small values like 31).

ORGANIZATION_SORT.name: organization_sort_key
ORGANIZATION_SORT.description: Numeric sort key (9-digit, ~101xxxxxx) used to order organizations hierarchically for display/reporting. Plausible but unconfirmed: it could instead be a concatenated hierarchy path (e.g. built from parent keys) rather than a simple sort order.

ORG_PARENT.name: parent_organization_code
ORG_PARENT.description: Code of the parent organization (e.g. 'PROVST', 'EXECVP', 'S ENG'); the code form of FCLT_ORG_PARENT_KEY; references FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (day-month-year strings like '01-MAY-15'), typically the 1st of a month.

table.name: FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY
table.purpose: Crosswalk table mapping MIT DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) codes to facility-space organization keys, linking the space/facilities system (FCLT_ORGANIZATION) to the department hierarchy (MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY). Each row is one DLC-to-organization mapping; 168 rows with 136 distinct DLC codes, so some DLCs map to multiple organizations (or multiple rows per DLC).

DLC_KEY.name: DLC code
DLC_KEY.description: Department, Lab, or Center (DLC) code, prefixed with 'D_' (e.g., D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_DUSP = Urban Studies and Planning, D_PROVOST, D_IS&T). References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY. Null for ~5% of rows, meaning some facility organizations have no DLC assigned.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: Facility organization key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Surrogate key of the facility organization record (joins to FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FAC_ORGANIZATION). Unique per row in this table; referenced by FCLT_ROOMS, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST, FAC_ROOMS, SPACE_UNIT, etc.

table.name: FCLT_ROOMS
table.purpose: Facilities room inventory: one row per room (or room-level space) in MIT buildings, with building/floor identifiers, floor area, space use classification, and owning organization. Companion to FAC_ROOMS/FCLT_ROOMS_HIST in a facilities space data warehouse.

ACCESS_LEVEL.name: Access level
ACCESS_LEVEL.description: Coded access/security level of the room, values 0-3. Exact meaning of each level is not documented elsewhere in the evidence; likely an ordinal room-access classification. Alternative reading: a generic room attribute code unrelated to security.

AREA.name: Room area
AREA.description: Floor area of the room, almost certainly in square feet (median ~140, max 108,475).

BUILDING_ROOM.name: Building-room identifier
BUILDING_ROOM.description: Building number plus room number, e.g. 'E37-799A' = building E37, room 799A. Same value as FCLT_ROOM_KEY.

EASTING_SPCS.name: Easting (SPCS)

HR_ORG_LEVEL2_SORT.description: Sort order for level-2 nodes (2, 3, 4; 623 for 'Other Org Units').

HR_ORG_LEVEL3_ID.name: Hierarchy level 3 unit ID
HR_ORG_LEVEL3_ID.description: ID of the level-3 hierarchy node (school/area level, e.g. Science Area, Engineering Area, Sloan School of Management Area).

HR_ORG_LEVEL3_NAME.name: Hierarchy level 3 name
HR_ORG_LEVEL3_NAME.description: Name of the level-3 school/area node, e.g. 'Science Area', 'Schwarzman College of Computing Area'.

HR_ORG_LEVEL3_SORT.name: Hierarchy level 3 sort order
HR_ORG_LEVEL3_SORT.description: Sort order for level-3 nodes within the hierarchy.

HR_ORG_LEVEL4_ID.name: Hierarchy level 4 unit ID
HR_ORG_LEVEL4_ID.description: ID of the level-4 hierarchy node (intermediate area/office level, e.g. 'Vice Chancellor Area', 'Open Learning Area').

HR_ORG_LEVEL4_NAME.name: Hierarchy level 4 name
HR_ORG_LEVEL4_NAME.description: Name of the level-4 node, e.g. 'SHASS area', 'Dof Facilities Operations'.

HR_ORG_LEVEL5_ID.name: Hierarchy level 5 unit ID
HR_ORG_LEVEL5_ID.description: ID of the level-5 hierarchy node (often the department itself when it sits below a level-4 area). Null when the unit is at level 4 or higher.

HR_ORG_LEVEL5_NAME.name: Hierarchy level 5 name
HR_ORG_LEVEL5_NAME.description: Name of the level-5 node, e.g. 'MIT Program in Women's & Gender Studies'. Null when the hierarchy stops at level 4.

HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.name: HR org unit ID
HR_ORG_UNIT_ID.description: Unique identifier of the org unit row (691 distinct values, no nulls); matches HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID one-to-one and is referenced by employee directory and facilities organization tables. For department rows it equals HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE.

HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY.name: HR org unit surrogate key
HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY.description: Text surrogate key formed as 'O' + zero-padded HR_ORG_UNIT_ID (e.g. O10000547); unique per row.

HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL.name: Org unit level category
HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL.description: Classification of the row's place in the hierarchy: ALL MIT, TOP LEVEL, ORGANIZATION LEVEL, DEPARTMENTS, SUB DEPARTMENT, NON HIERARCHY ORG UNITS.

HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE.name: Org unit title
HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE.description: Title/name of the org unit itself (the row's own node), e.g. 'Laboratory for Nuclear Science'.

ORG_HIER_ROOT_NAME.name: Hierarchy root name
ORG_HIER_ROOT_NAME.description: Name of the root of the org hierarchy; constant 'MIT-All' (duplicate of HR_ORG_LEVEL1_NAME).

ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME.name: School/area name (denormalized)
ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME.description: Denormalized name of the school/area the unit belongs to (same vocabulary as HR_ORG_LEVEL3_NAME, e.g. 'Science Area', 'VP Research').

ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME.name: Top-level senior area name (denormalized)
ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME.description: Denormalized name of the top-level senior area (Provost Area, Executive Vice President Area, President & Chair of the Corporation), same vocabulary as HR_ORG_LEVEL2_NAME.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the warehouse, in DD-MON-YY format (03-DEC-24 for almost all rows, 13-DEC-24 for one).

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY
table.purpose: Lookup table of categories used to classify MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) non-credit subjects/activities. Each row is one category with a name, optional description, and a surrogate key referenced by IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL. 49 rows, one per category (e.g., 'A.I. and Robotics', 'Cooking', 'Boston and Cambridge').

IAP_CATEGORY_DESC.name: category_description
IAP_CATEGORY_DESC.description: Free-text description of the category, listing example topics/activities (e.g., 'Cooking classes, wine and cheese tastings...'). Null for ~24.5% of categories that have no description.

IAP_CATEGORY_NAME.name: category_name
IAP_CATEGORY_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the IAP category (e.g., 'A.I. and Robotics', 'Health and Fitness', 'Special Events'). Nearly unique per row (48 distinct in 49 rows).

IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY.name: iap_subject_category_key
IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY.description: Surrogate primary key (32-char hex, two apparent generations of key formats). Referenced by IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, linking each IAP subject to its category.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot. Stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL
table.purpose: Detail/descriptive attributes of MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) non-credit activities for the January 2021 term: title, description, category, sponsor, enrollment/attendance rules, fees, and prerequisites. One row per IAP activity (linked to its session and contact person via surrogate keys).

ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION.name: Activity description
ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION.description: HTML-formatted long description of the IAP activity.

ACTIVITY_TITLE.name: Activity title
ACTIVITY_TITLE.description: Title of the IAP activity as shown in the IAP catalog.

ATTENDANCE.name: Attendance policy
ATTENDANCE.description: Attendance requirement: 'Participants welcome at individual sessions', 'Participants must attend all sessions', or 'Other'.

CREATE_DATE.name: Creation date
CREATE_DATE.description: Date the activity record was created, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 18-DEC-20).

ENROLLMENT_TYPE.name: Enrollment/sign-up type
ENROLLMENT_TYPE.description: How participants enroll: advance sign-up required, no advance sign-up, first come first served, or other.

FEE.name: Fee amount (USD)
FEE.description: Fee charged for the activity in US dollars; null for ~94% of rows (free activities). Values 10-168.

FEE_REASON.name: Fee reason
FEE_REASON.description: Explanation of what the fee covers (e.g. class registration, kit and fabricated parts, per-lesson pricing).

IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY.name: IAP category key
IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY.description: Surrogate key referencing IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY (e.g. Climate, Economics and Finance, Diversity and Inclusion).

IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.name: IAP contact person key
IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.description: Surrogate key for the activity's contact/organizer person; presumably references IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON (no accepted join detected, but identical value distribution to IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY suggests it identifies the activity's person record).

IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.name: IAP session key
IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.description: Surrogate key referencing IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION, identifying the activity/session this detail row belongs to. No accepted join was detected, so the exact target is inferred from naming.

IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.name: IAP sponsor key
IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.description: Surrogate key referencing IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR (e.g. Lincoln Laboratory, Biology, Libraries).

IS_CANCELLED.name: Cancelled flag
IS_CANCELLED.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the activity was cancelled (only 2 of 465 were).

IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION.name: Multiple session flag
IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the activity runs over multiple sessions (Y for 426 of 465).

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Last activity date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date of the last session/update of the activity, DD-MON-YY format; all within the IAP January 2021 window.

MAX_ENROLLMENT.name: Maximum enrollment
MAX_ENROLLMENT.description: Maximum number of participants allowed; null for ~70% of rows (no cap). Range 6-200.

PREREG_DEADLINE.name: Pre-registration deadline
PREREG_DEADLINE.description: Deadline to sign up in advance, DD-MON-YY format; null when no advance sign-up is required.

PREREQUISITES.name: Prerequisites
PREREQUISITES.description: Free-text prerequisites or requirements for participation; null for ~70% of rows.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code; single value '2021JA' = January IAP 2021. Likely joins to ACADEMIC_TERMS, though no accepted join was detected.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of this row into the data warehouse (19-DEC-24 for all rows).

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON
table.purpose: People associated with MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) subjects/activities, with their role (activity leader, session leader, contact person) and contact details. Each row is one person-role assignment for an IAP offering, keyed by a surrogate hash that likely also encodes the parent subject/session (IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL / IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION).

IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.name: IAP subject-person link key
IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY.description: Surrogate hash key for the row; 390 distinct values across 1113 rows suggests it identifies the parent IAP subject/session, with multiple person-role rows sharing the same key. Not a unique row identifier.

PERSON_EMAIL.name: Person email address
PERSON_EMAIL.description: Email address of the person; values use a masked/anonymized domain 'worker.com' (and hotmail.com), so these appear to be scrubbed test or privacy-masked data rather than real addresses.

PERSON_LOCATION.name: Office/room location
PERSON_LOCATION.description: MIT building-room location (e.g. NW16-250, E23-392A) where the person can be found; format matches MIT building/room codes.

PERSON_MIT_AFFILIATION.name: MIT affiliation
PERSON_MIT_AFFILIATION.description: Person's relationship to MIT: Staff, Non-MIT, Research Staff, Other MIT, MIT Professor, Grad Student, Instruct. Staff, Sophomore, etc.

PERSON_NAME.name: Person full name
PERSON_NAME.description: Full name of the person; values look like synthetic/fictional names, consistent with anonymized data.

PERSON_ROLE.name: Role in IAP offering
PERSON_ROLE.description: The person's role for the IAP subject: Activity leader, Contact person, or Session leader.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; single value 19-DEC-24 for all rows (full snapshot load).

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION
table.purpose: Individual meeting/session records for MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) subjects — one row per scheduled session (date, times, location, title/description) of an IAP offering, keyed to the IAP subject detail table. Data appears to be from IAP January 2021 (mostly virtual/Zoom sessions).

HAS_SESSION_INFO.name: has_session_info
HAS_SESSION_INFO.description: Flag indicating whether the subject has session-level scheduling info; 'Y' for nearly all rows, 'N' for 18 rows (likely subjects with no session detail).

IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.name: iap_subject_session_key
IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY.description: Opaque surrogate key linking the session to its parent IAP subject (presumably joins to IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL); not unique here, so multiple sessions share a subject key.

SESSION_DATE.name: session_date
SESSION_DATE.description: Date of the session, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g., 14-JAN-21); all dates fall in January 2021, consistent with IAP.

SESSION_DESCRIPTION.name: session_description
SESSION_DESCRIPTION.description: HTML-formatted free-text description of the session's content (e.g., 'Course Intro and Chapter 1'); null for about half the rows.

SESSION_END_TIME.name: session_end_time
SESSION_END_TIME.description: Session end time as text in HHMMAM/PM format (e.g., '0300PM' = 3:00 PM).

SESSION_LOCATION.name: session_location
SESSION_LOCATION.description: Where the session is held; free text dominated by virtual/Zoom variants for 2021, otherwise a room or building name.

SESSION_START_TIME.name: session_start_time
SESSION_START_TIME.description: Session start time as text in HHMMAM/PM format (e.g., '0100PM' = 1:00 PM).

SESSION_TITLE.name: session_title
SESSION_TITLE.description: Title of the individual session (e.g., 'Session 4: Transmission expansion'); null when the session has no distinct title.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

table.name: IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR
table.purpose: Lookup table of sponsors (departments, centers, labs, student groups, etc.) that sponsor MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) subjects; referenced by IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.

IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.name: IAP sponsor surrogate key
IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.description: Primary key; opaque system-generated hex identifier (two different formats appear, suggesting data merged from two source systems). Referenced by IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY.

SPONSOR_NAME.name: Sponsor name
SPONSOR_NAME.description: Display name of the sponsoring unit, e.g. 'Lincoln Laboratory', 'Biology', 'Society of Physics Students'. Nearly unique (one null, 67 distinct in 68 rows).

SPONSOR_TYPE.name: Sponsor type
SPONSOR_TYPE.description: Classification of the sponsor: Academic Department, Administrative Department, Student Group, Center, Lab, Other MIT Groups.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load timestamp of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, so it reflects batch load time, not a business date.

table.name: IR_INSTITUTION
table.purpose: Institutional Research reference table of higher-education institutions worldwide (one row per institution), with name, address, country, and Carnegie-classification category. Likely used to code institutions of origin (e.g., for transfer/exchange/study-abroad or prior-education data) in an MIT institutional research warehouse.

ALTERNATE_INSTITUTION_NAME.name: alternate_institution_name
ALTERNATE_INSTITUTION_NAME.description: Alternate or former name of the institution; populated for about 15% of rows.

CITY.name: city
CITY.description: City in which the institution is located.

COUNTRY.name: country
COUNTRY.description: Full country name of the institution's location (uppercase standardized names, e.g. UNITED STATES, JAPAN).

COUNTRY_CODE.name: country_code
COUNTRY_CODE.description: Two-letter ISO country code matching COUNTRY (US, JP, CN, ...).

INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_LABEL.name: institution_category_label
INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_LABEL.description: Human-readable Carnegie Classification category of the institution (e.g. 'Master's Colleges and Universities (larger programs)'); '-3' value corresponds to 'Not applicable, not in Carnegie universe (not accredited or nondegree-granting)'. Trailing newline present in values.

INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_VALUE.name: institution_category_value
INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_VALUE.description: Numeric code for the Carnegie Classification category, paired 1:1 with INSTITUTION_CATEGORY_LABEL; -3 = not in Carnegie universe. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious (room-use codes, unrelated domain) and should be ignored.

INSTITUTION_ID.name: institution_id
INSTITUTION_ID.description: Primary key; unique institution identifier. Six-digit numeric IDs (e.g. 225548) resemble IPEDS/Dept. of Education OPE or FICE codes; IDs prefixed 'F' (e.g. F01323) appear to be a local code for foreign institutions.

INSTITUTION_SORT_ORDER.name: institution_sort_order
INSTITUTION_SORT_ORDER.description: Numeric sort key controlling display order of institutions (e.g. in pick lists); 900/999 likely place US or uncategorized entries last. Exact ordering scheme unresolved.

RECORD_CREATED_DATE.name: record_created_date
RECORD_CREATED_DATE.description: Date the record was loaded/created, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format; bulk load 17-JUL-14 with later incremental loads in 2024.

STATE.name: state
STATE.description: Two-letter US state/territory code (includes PR); null for non-US institutions.

STREET_ADDRESS.name: street_address
STREET_ADDRESS.description: Street address of the institution (mixed formatting/case).

ZIP.name: zip
ZIP.description: US ZIP (or ZIP+4) postal code; null for non-US rows. Some values like 96941 (Guam) and low values suggest non-US postal codes may also appear.

table.name: LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR
table.purpose: Maps MIT courses (by subject number, term, and instructor) to the MIT library unit (branch) that holds reserves or supports that course, with the course's term date range and warehouse load metadata. Each row is one course-instructor-term assignment linked to a library unit.

COURSE_NAME.name: course_title
COURSE_NAME.description: Human-readable title of the course/subject (e.g. 'Calculus', 'Chinese I (Streamlined)').

DATE_FROM.name: term_start_date
DATE_FROM.description: Start date of the course's term, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format (e.g. 06-SEP-11 = fall 2011 term start).

DATE_TO.name: term_end_date
DATE_TO.description: End date of the course's term, DD-MON-YY text format. The value 31-MAY-31 appears to be a placeholder/far-future date for open-ended records.

DEPARTMENT.name: department
DEPARTMENT.description: Academic department offering the course, either as 'code - name' (MIT course number format, e.g. '21F - Foreign Languages/Literatures') or a plain department name (e.g. 'History'). Inconsistent formatting suggests mixed sources.

INSTRUCTOR_NAME.name: instructor_name
INSTRUCTOR_NAME.description: Instructor of the course in 'Last, First' format. High distinctness (9591/10000) indicates one row per instructor per course-term.

LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.name: course_instructor_key
LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.description: Primary key, composite string of course number, instructor surname, and term code (e.g. '21F.107-KIDD2011SU:21F.107'). The suffix after the colon is the course number, which may differ from the prefix when the subject is cross-listed (e.g. '17.100J-PRUITT2009FA:15.678').

UNIT.name: library_unit_name
UNIT.description: MIT library branch responsible for the course's reserves: Hayden, Barker, Dewey, Rotch, or Lewis Music. Null when no library unit is assigned.

UNIT_CODE.name: library_unit_code
UNIT_CODE.description: Code for the library unit (ENG=Barker/engineering, DEW=Dewey, RTC=Rotch, MUS=Lewis Music, Hayden stored as its name). Some values combine two units ('Hayden & ENG', 'DEW & Hayden'), indicating shared responsibility. Null when UNIT is null.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, DD-MON-YY text format; an ETL audit column, not a business date.

table.name: LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS
table.purpose: Lookup table of material status codes for library course reserve materials (e.g., required textbook, reserve-only, no required textbook). Referenced by LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.name: material_status_description
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.description: Human-readable label of the material status: 'Required Course Material', 'Non-Required Course Material', 'Reserve only', 'No Required Textbook', 'Unknown'. Null for one row (likely the 'Y' code whose label is missing).

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.name: material_status_code
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.description: Single-letter code for the material status, duplicating LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY: U=Unknown, N=Non-Required Course Material, R=Required Course Material, O=Reserve only, X=No Required Textbook, Y=Required Course Material (per the referencing LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL documentation).

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.name: material_status_key
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.description: Primary key; single-letter code joined to LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY. Same values as LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (23-DEC-21 for all rows); ETL metadata, not business data.

table.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG
table.purpose: Library catalog records for materials placed on course reserve at the MIT Libraries. Each row is one reserve item's bibliographic record (author, title, call number, ISBN, publisher, year) keyed by the library catalog system number, with record-creation/update and warehouse-load timestamps. Likely the catalog side joined to LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL for reserve transactions. The many rows with null bibliographic fields and year 0 appear to be placeholder/incomplete records (e.g., cross-listed courses pointing to a URL reading list, or records lacking catalog data).

CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME.name: author_name
CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME.description: Author of the reserve item, in library-catalog format (name with dates, e.g. 'Shakespeare, William, 1564-1616.'). Null for ~53% of records (non-book items or incomplete records).

CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER.name: call_number
CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER.description: Library of Congress call number of the item (e.g. 'QA303.S5547 1996'). Non-LC values like 'Professor Collection', 'Personal Copy', 'RESERVE VIDEO' indicate non-cataloged reserve materials (instructor's copies, videos).

CATALOG_ISBN.name: isbn
CATALOG_ISBN.description: ISBN of the item, sometimes with qualifiers such as '(pbk.)' or '(alk. paper)'. Some malformed values (e.g. '028947421023') suggest dirty data.

CATALOG_PUBLISHER.name: publication_statement
CATALOG_PUBLISHER.description: Full MARC-style publication statement: place : publisher, date (e.g. 'New York : McGraw-Hill, 1996.'). Not just the publisher name.

CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE.name: catalog_record_create_date
CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE.description: Date the catalog record was created in the library system, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format.

CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE.name: catalog_record_update_date
CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE.description: Date the catalog record was last updated, DD-MON-YY text format. The dominant value 02-FEB-09 suggests a bulk update/migration on that date.

CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER.name: catalog_system_number
CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER.description: Library catalog system record number (bibliographic record ID). Identical to LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY in every sample; effectively the natural key of the catalog record.

CATALOG_TITLE.name: title
CATALOG_TITLE.description: Title (and statement of responsibility) of the reserve item. Some rows instead contain a note that the course is cross-listed and readings are at a URL, i.e. no physical reserve item.

CATALOG_YEAR.name: publication_year
CATALOG_YEAR.description: Year of publication; 0 (2785 rows) means unknown/missing, not a real year. Non-zero values range 1960-2020.

LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.name: reserve_catalog_key
LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; equals the library catalog system number (CATALOG_SYSTEM_NUMBER).

RECORD_COUNTER.name: record_counter
RECORD_COUNTER.description: Constant value 1 on every row; a row-count/ETL helper column, carries no information.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded/refreshed into the data warehouse, DD-MON-YY text format.

table.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL
table.purpose: Fact table linking library reserve materials (course reserve items) to the course/instructor/term for which they were placed on reserve, with the material's required-status code. One row = one reserve material assigned to one course offering (subject + term + instructor).

LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.name: LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY.description: Composite key identifying a course-instructor-term combination; format '<subject(s)>-<INSTRUCTOR><TERM>:<subject>'. References LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR (no accepted join detected, but format matches that table's key pattern).

LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.name: LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY.description: Code indicating whether the reserve material is required for the course: U=Unknown, N=Non-Required Course Material, O=Reserve only, X=No Required Textbook, Y=Required Course Material. References LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS.

LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.name: LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY.description: Numeric identifier of the reserve item in the library reserve catalog; references LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG (join not detected by statistics but name and one-to-many cardinality imply it).

LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.name: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.description: Key of the course offering: subject number concatenated with term code (e.g. '21M.2622009FA'). References LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.

SUBJECT_ID.name: SUBJECT_ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject/course number (e.g. '21M.240', 'HST.S11') of the course the reserve material is for.

TERM_CODE.name: TERM_CODE
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code (e.g. 2009FA, 2008SP) in which the material was placed on reserve. References ACADEMIC_TERMS / ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse (Oracle DD-MON-YY format); each term's rows were loaded on one date.

table.name: LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: Library-oriented fact table of MIT subject (course) offerings per academic term: one row per subject offered in a term, with the offering department, school, responsible faculty member, and enrollment count. Key combines subject ID and term code (e.g. 10.543 + 2014SP). Appears to be a library warehouse copy of SUBJECT_OFFERED data spanning roughly 2008-2021 terms (FA/SP/SU/JA).

COURSE_NUMBER.name: offering_department_course_code
COURSE_NUMBER.description: MIT course (department/subject-area) code of the offering department, e.g. 15=Management, 18=Mathematics, 21F=Foreign Languages/Literatures, 2=Mechanical Engineering. References SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER.

COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: offering_department_name
COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Human-readable name of the offering department/course code (e.g. 15 -> Management).

COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.name: offering_department_code_sort_key
COURSE_NUMBER_SORT.description: Zero/space-padded version of COURSE_NUMBER used for correct lexicographic sorting (e.g. '  2' for course 2).

LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.name: surrogate_primary_key
LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of SUBJECT_ID and TERM_CODE (e.g. '10.543' + '2014SP' = '10.5432014SP').

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.name: master_course_code
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.description: Course code of the subject's master/owning department (may differ from offering department, e.g. subject 10.543 offered by ChemE but master course 7=Biology). Includes codes like STS, 21G.

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: master_course_code_description
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Name of the master course code (e.g. 7 -> Biology, 21G -> Global Languages).

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject identifier under the master course numbering (e.g. 7.88), i.e. the subject's canonical/home ID; may differ from the offered SUBJECT_ID.

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: enrollment_count
NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.description: Number of students enrolled in the subject offering that term (0-673, median 12).

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: offering_department_code

table.name: MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY
table.purpose: Master list of MIT departments, labs, and centers (DLCs) with their position in the standard administrative hierarchy (Institute -> executive area -> school/VP area -> sub-area). One row per DLC (310 rows). Referenced by HR, space, facilities, SIS, and finance tables as the canonical DLC key. The hierarchy is flattened into level columns; levels 4 and 5 are populated only for a few DLCs and level 5 is entirely empty. A companion table, MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY_LINKS, presumably holds the same hierarchy in link (parent/child) form, and MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT maps each D_CODE to its parent code. The DLC_CODE and DLC_KEY columns are identical in content; DLC_KEY is the detected primary key and the one most other tables join on, while DLC_CODE additionally joins one-to-one to MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.D_CODE, suggesting DLC_CODE is the 'department code' alias of the same identifier. HIERARCHY_TYPE is constant ('Standard Hierarchy'), implying other hierarchy types may exist elsewhere or were planned. Level 2 groups DLCs by executive area (Provost, EVP, President, etc.); level 3 by school or VP office (School of Engineering, VP Research, Dean for Student Life, etc.); level 4 by sub-area within a level-3 unit (e.g., Sourcing Area within the EVP area).

DLC_CODE.name: DLC code (department/lab/center code)
DLC_CODE.description: Code identifying the department, lab, or center, prefixed 'D_' (e.g., D_PSFC = Plasma Sciences & Fusion Center, D_MATHS = Mathematics). Identical in value to DLC_KEY; this copy joins one-to-one to MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT.D_CODE, so it acts as the department-code alias of the DLC identifier.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC key (primary key)
DLC_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; the canonical department/lab/center identifier (e.g., D_PSFC, D_MATHS) used by HR_ORG_UNIT, SIS_DEPARTMENT, SPACE_UNIT, FCLT_ORGANIZATION, ROLES_FIN_PA and other tables to reference a DLC.
