table.name: ROLES_FIN_PA
table.purpose: Assigns MIT users (by username/Kerberos ID) to DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) keys, likely granting financial/PA (project accounting) roles per DLC. Each row is one user-to-DLC role assignment; users can hold roles in multiple DLCs and DLCs can have many users.

DLC_KEY.name: DLC_KEY
DLC_KEY.description: Department, Lab, or Center (DLC) identifier code, prefixed 'D_' (e.g. D_MECHE = Mechanical Engineering, D_CHEME = Chemical Engineering, D_BIOENG = Biological Engineering). References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY; many users per DLC.

USERNAME.name: USERNAME
USERNAME.description: MIT user/Kerberos username of the person holding a financial role in the given DLC. Not unique — a user can have roles in multiple DLCs (e.g. 'enzom' appears 65 times).

table.name: SE_PERSON
table.purpose: Directory of active MIT persons (employees, students, and other affiliates) with names, Kerberos usernames, employee classification, payroll rank, organizational unit, and office location. One row per person, keyed by MIT_ID. Likely a data-warehouse person table (SE = 'special extract' or similar) feeding other reporting tables; related to EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY / DRUPAL_EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY / OPA_PERSON_CURRENT in the same database. Data appears anonymized/synthetic (names and IDs randomized), but structure is consistent with the MIT data warehouse person table.

EMPLOYEE_TYPE.name: employee_type
EMPLOYEE_TYPE.description: Broad classification of the person's relationship to MIT: Student, Faculty, Admin Staff, Support Staff, Sponsored Research Staff, Other Academic Group, Service Staff, Medical. 8 distinct categories.

FULL_NAME.name: full_name
FULL_NAME.description: Person's full name in 'Last, First [Middle]' format; occasionally includes a suffix or second middle token (e.g. 'Robbins, Yasir Odonnell.').

IS_ACTIVE.name: is_active
IS_ACTIVE.description: Flag indicating the person is currently active; all rows in this extract are 'Y'. Stored as VARCHAR 'Y'/'N' rather than a true boolean.

KRB_NAME.name: kerberos_username
KRB_NAME.description: MIT Kerberos/Athena account username, typically derived from the person's name (first initial + last name, with numeric suffixes for collisions). Not unique in this data (53% distinct), likely due to anonymization or shared usernames.

MIDDLE_NAME.name: middle_name
MIDDLE_NAME.description: Person's middle name or middle initial; null for ~53% of persons.

MIT_ID.name: mit_id
MIT_ID.description: MIT unique person identifier (9-digit number in the 900000000-999999999 range). Primary key of the table; one row per person.

OFFICE_LOCATION.name: office_location
OFFICE_LOCATION.description: MIT building/room office location in the standard 'building-room' format (e.g. 'E53-355', '5-172F', 'NW12-264G'); some values are building number only (e.g. '46', 'E23'). Null for ~37% (persons without an assigned office, e.g. students). Building codes correspond to the BUILDINGS/FAC_BUILDING tables.

ORGANIZATION.name: organization
ORGANIZATION.description: MIT department or organizational unit the person belongs to (e.g. 'Electrical Engineering-Computer Science', 'Sloan School of Management', 'MIT Health'). 320 distinct units.

PAYROLL_RANK.name: payroll_rank
PAYROLL_RANK.description: Payroll classification/rank code (26 distinct values), e.g. 'Grad Std Fellow' (graduate student fellow), 'Grad Std RA' (graduate research assistant), 'Admin Staff', 'Dept Hd/Dir-Ten' (tenured department head/director), 'Inst Professors' (institute professors).

table.name: SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT
table.purpose: Administrative department reference table from MIT's Student Information System: one row per administrative/academic department code, with its name, phone number, and cost-collector number. Referenced by course/subject tables to map subjects to departments.

CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR.name: clearing_cost_collector_number
CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR.description: Financial clearing/cost collector number assigned to the department (SAP-style cost center identifier, 7-digit). Null for departments without an assigned cost collector. Alternative reading: a general ledger clearing account number; no join evidence distinguishes the two.

DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE.name: department_phone_area_code
DEPARTMENT_PHONE_AREA_CODE.description: Telephone area code for the department's phone number, stored separately from the 7-digit local number in DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER (MIT campus numbers are in the 617 area code).

DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER.name: department_phone_number
DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER.description: Department's 7-digit campus phone number (MIT 617-area local number, stored without area code). Null for ~57% of departments.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the department record was last created or updated in the source system, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format. Many dates are from the 1990s, indicating a largely static reference table.

SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: sis_admin_department_code
SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Primary key: the SIS administrative department code (e.g. AERO, BE, 21F, 15D). Referenced by SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_SUMMARY, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, and COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED to assign subjects to departments.

SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: sis_admin_department_name
SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Full name of the administrative department (e.g. 'Biological Engineering Div.', 'Baptist Ministry', 'School of Engineering Office').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (single value 19-DEC-24 for all rows, i.e. the last full refresh).

table.name: SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION
table.purpose: MIT Student Information System course/program-of-study reference table. Each row is a course (departmental degree program) with an optional option/track, at a given level (undergraduate or graduate), valid over a term range, with descriptive attributes such as school, department, CIP classification, degree-granting flag, and default ultimate degree. Keyed by department:option:level. This is a slowly-changing-dimension style table (FROM_TERM/THRU_TERM validity).

CIP_PROGRAM_CODE.name: CIP program code
CIP_PROGRAM_CODE.description: US NCES Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code for the course/program; references CIP.PROGRAM_CODE.

COURSE.name: Course code
COURSE.description: Course identifier, typically the department/subject number plus an option suffix (e.g. '24', '3 P', 'HST AEM'). Corresponds to the department portion of the key plus option. Tentative: it may instead be a purely display-oriented concatenation of department and option rather than an independent identifier.

COURSE_DESCRIPTION.name: Course short description
COURSE_DESCRIPTION.description: Short/abbreviated name of the course or program (e.g. 'Linguistics & Philosophy', 'Mat Sci & Eng - M.Eng').

COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG.name: Course long description
COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG.description: Full/official name of the course or program (e.g. 'Linguistics and Philosophy', 'Health Sciences and Technology').

COURSE_LEVEL.name: Course level
COURSE_LEVEL.description: Level of the course: 'G' = Graduate, 'U' = Undergraduate.

COURSE_OPTION.name: Course option code
COURSE_OPTION.description: Option/track within the course (e.g. 'P', 'AEM', 'NIV', 'NIE'). Null when the course has no option. Tentative: individual code meanings are unclear; NIV/NIE may denote non-Institute exchange or special programs (cf. STUDENT_DEPARTMENT's alphabetic special-program codes), but this is not confirmed.

DEFAULT_ULTIMATE_DEGREE.name: Default ultimate degree
DEFAULT_ULTIMATE_DEGREE.description: MIT degree abbreviation expected for students in this course: NDG = no degree granted, SM = Master of Science, SB = Bachelor of Science, DOC = Doctorate, MNG = Master of Engineering, plus others (MBA, MCP, HA).

DEPARTMENT.name: Department code
DEPARTMENT.description: MIT department/course code owning the course (e.g. '12' = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, '15' = Management, 'HST' = Health Sciences & Technology); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Short name of the department matching DEPARTMENT code (e.g. 'Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci').

DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: Department name in commencement book
DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal department name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'Department of Linguistics and Philosophy'). Null for non-degree/cross-enrollment rows.

FROM_TERM.name: From term
FROM_TERM.description: Term code (e.g. 2001FA, 2015JA) from which this course description row is effective; '000000' = Beginning of Time. Format YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA.

FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: From term description
FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable description of FROM_TERM (e.g. 'Fall Term 2000-2001', 'Beginning of Time').

GRADAUTE_LEVEL.name: Graduate level (misspelled duplicate)
GRADAUTE_LEVEL.description: Graduate sub-level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for undergraduate/non-degree rows. Appears to be a misspelled duplicate of GRADUATE_LEVEL.

GRADUATE_LEVEL.name: Graduate level
GRADUATE_LEVEL.description: Graduate sub-level: 'Masters' or 'Doctoral'; null for undergraduate/non-degree rows.

IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.name: Is degree granting
IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the course is a degree-granting program.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: Last activity date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the record was last updated in the source system, in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 23-JUL-15).

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Abbreviated MIT school the course belongs to (Engineering, Science, Hum Arts & Social Sciences, Architecture and Planning, MIT academic, Non-MIT, etc.).

SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: School name in commencement book
SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal school name as printed in the commencement program book (e.g. 'School of Engineering').

SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY.name: SIS course description key
SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY.description: Primary key: composite of DEPARTMENT : COURSE_OPTION : COURSE_LEVEL (e.g. '24::G', '3:P:G', 'HST:AEM:G').

THRU_TERM.name: Through term
THRU_TERM.description: Term code through which this course description row is effective; '999999' = End of Time (currently active). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

THRU_TERM_DESCRIPTION.name: Through term description
THRU_TERM_DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable description of THRU_TERM (e.g. 'Fall Term 2003-2004', 'End of Time').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant 19-DEC-24 for this snapshot.

table.name: SIS_DEPARTMENT
table.purpose: MIT Student Information System reference table of academic/administrative departments (one row per department code), with school affiliation, degree-granting flag, budget code, DLC key, and commencement-program naming variants. Referenced by student and subject tables via DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Short SIS department code (MIT course number like '1', '21F', '4', or alpha codes like 'HASS', 'ODGE', 'ARC'). Nearly unique (127 distinct of 128 rows, one null).

DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.name: department_full_name
DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.description: Canonical department identifier: code + '-' + name (e.g. '1-Civil and Environmental Eng'). Used as join key by STUDENT_DEPARTMENT and SUBJECT_GROUPING.

DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: department_last_activity_date
DEPARTMENT_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date of last recorded activity/change for the department record, in Oracle DD-MON-YY format. Many rows share 17-FEB-94, suggesting a bulk load then.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable department name without the code prefix (e.g. 'History', 'Anthropology').

DEPARTMENT_NAME_HISTORY.name: department_name_history
DEPARTMENT_NAME_HISTORY.description: Historical/renaming notes for the department (e.g. 'Anthropol/Archaeol until 1998-99', 'was BEHS'). Populated for only ~10% of rows.

DEPT_BUDGET_CODE.name: dept_budget_code
DEPT_BUDGET_CODE.description: Numeric budget/accounting code assigned to the department (values 30000-446900). Null for ~30% of departments (non-budget entities like cross-registration programs).

DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: dept_name_in_commencement_booklet
DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal department name as printed in the commencement program booklet (e.g. 'Department of Aeronautics and Astronautics'). Null for departments not appearing in commencement.

DLC_KEY.name: dlc_key
DLC_KEY.description: Key to the DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) hierarchy; joins to MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY / MASTER_DEPT_DCODE_PARENT. Values like 'D_CROSS_REG', 'D_DHSS'.

IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.name: is_degree_granting
IS_DEGREE_GRANTING.description: Y/N flag indicating whether the department grants degrees.

SCHOOL_CODE.name: school_code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Code of the MIT school the department belongs to: E=Engineering, H=Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, Y=MIT academic (Science etc.), Z=Non-MIT, X=MIT non-academic, plus others (T, S).

SCHOOL_NAME.name: school_name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT').

SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: school_name_in_commencement_booklet
SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Formal school name as printed in the commencement program (e.g. 'School of Engineering'). Null where not applicable.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows.

table.name: SIS_LOOKUP
table.purpose: Generic code-description lookup table for the Student Information System (SIS), holding code sets such as registration status, enrollment status, load level, registration group, and registration type. Each row is one code within one lookup category. The 6th LOOKUP_TYPE value (sample 'HGN') is unresolved as to meaning.

CODE.name: code
CODE.description: Short alphanumeric code within a lookup category (e.g. RE = Registered, N = New Regular Grad Student). Not unique across categories, so it is only meaningful together with LOOKUP_TYPE. A few rows have null CODE.

DESCRIPTION.name: description
DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable meaning of the code (e.g. 'Registered', 'Dropped, No Tuition', '3/4 Time', 'Listener'). One row has the placeholder '?', i.e. unknown description.

LOOKUP_TYPE.name: lookup_type
LOOKUP_TYPE.description: Category of the code set: Registration Status, Enrollment Status, Load Level, Registration Group, Registration Type, and one unidentified type (sample value 'HGN') whose meaning is unresolved.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; all rows show 19-DEC-24, indicating a single full load. Stored as text in DD-MON-YY format.

table.name: SIS_SUBJECT_CODE
table.purpose: Lookup/dimension table of MIT subject (course) codes from the Student Information System, mapping each subject code to its owning department and school. Includes MIT course numbers (e.g. 11 = Urban Studies and Planning) and non-MIT/cross-enrollment codes (Wellesley, Harvard, MFA programs). Referenced by course offering tables (SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED).

COURSE_NUMBER.name: Subject (course) code
COURSE_NUMBER.description: Primary key. The subject/course code (e.g. '11', 'MCI', '21F') used to join to course offering and catalog tables. Appears identical to SUBJECT_CODE.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Owning department code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Code of the academic department that owns the subject; references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE and SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT. Values include MIT department numbers ('11', '12', '1', '15') and non-MIT codes (NIW = Wellesley Cross-Enrollment, NIA = Non-Institute MFA/MCA, NIH = Harvard Cross-Enrollment).

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department full name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the owning department, matching DEPARTMENT_CODE (e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'Wellesley Cross-Enrollment Pro').

SCHOOL_CODE.name: School code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Code of the MIT school the department belongs to (A = Architecture and Planning, E = Engineering, H = Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, S = Science, Z = Non-MIT, etc.). No join detected, so specific code meanings beyond those inferred from SCHOOL_NAME are tentative.

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Non-MIT', 'Architecture and Planning').

SUBJECT_CODE.name: Subject code (duplicate of COURSE_NUMBER)
SUBJECT_CODE.description: Same values as COURSE_NUMBER; the subject/course code. Not part of the primary key but duplicates it.

SUBJECT_CODE_DESC.name: Subject code description
SUBJECT_CODE_DESC.description: Human-readable description/title of the subject code (e.g. 'Urban Studies and Planning', 'Studio for Interrelated Media'); for cross-enrollment codes often the partner institution and notes like 'old'.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load timestamp of the row into the data warehouse; single value '19-DEC-24' for all rows (stored as text, Oracle-style DD-MON-YY).

table.name: SIS_TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY
table.purpose: Lookup table from the MIT Student Information System categorizing student term-time addresses/living groups (dormitories, fraternities, sororities, ILGs, off-campus) with a code, description, and living-group type, plus effective-date and warehouse audit fields.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the row was last updated in the source system (Oracle-style DD-MON-YY text).

LIVING_GROUP_TYPE.name: LIVING_GROUP_TYPE
LIVING_GROUP_TYPE.description: Single-letter code for the type of living group: D=Dormitory, F=Fraternity, S=Sorority, I=ILG (Independent Living Group), O=Off Campus; null rows correspond to 'Unknown'.

LIVING_GROUP_TYPE_DESC.name: LIVING_GROUP_TYPE_DESC
LIVING_GROUP_TYPE_DESC.description: Text description of the living-group type: Dormitory, Fraternity, Sorority, ILG, Off Campus, Unknown.

TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY.name: TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY
TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY.description: Name/label of the term-time address category, i.e. the specific living group or address (e.g. dormitory names like Westgate Lowrise, fraternity/sorority names like Alpha Phi, or street addresses like 405 Memorial Dr).

TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY_CODE.name: TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY_CODE
TERM_ADDRESS_CATEGORY_CODE.description: Primary key: short code identifying the term address category (e.g. PKA for pika, WGA for Westgate, numeric codes for street addresses).

VALID_FROM_DATE.name: VALID_FROM_DATE
VALID_FROM_DATE.description: Effective start date of the category record (DD-MON-YY text); 01-JAN-60 appears as a default/earliest date.

VALID_THRU_DATE.name: VALID_THRU_DATE
VALID_THRU_DATE.description: Effective end date of the category record; null (85%) means still active.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (19-DEC-24 for all rows, i.e. the latest full load).

table.name: SPACE_DETAIL
table.purpose: Room-level space inventory: one row per room (or room subdivision) in a building, with its floor, room number, square footage, assigned organizational unit, and space usage classification. Appears to be a flattened detail of the FAC/FCLT rooms data (MIT-style building-room numbering like 10-436E).

BUILDING_COMPONENT.name: building_component
BUILDING_COMPONENT.description: Building number/component code (e.g. '10', '32', '42T'); in sampled rows it matches BUILDING_KEY, but includes non-numeric variants like '42T', so it may distinguish building components or sub-buildings. Exact distinction from BUILDING_KEY is unresolved.

BUILDING_KEY.name: building_key
BUILDING_KEY.description: Building number (MIT building number, 1-45). The statistics-based join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is spurious (usage labels like 'DINING RM' don't fit building numbers); the real referent is likely BUILDINGS/FAC_BUILDING, not detected.

BUILDING_ROOM.name: building_room
BUILDING_ROOM.description: Full room identifier in 'building-room' format, e.g. 10-436E, 32-G404H. Nearly unique per row.

BUILDING_ROOM_NAME.name: building_room_name
BUILDING_ROOM_NAME.description: Duplicate of BUILDING_ROOM (identical values in all samples); presumably a display name for the room.

FLOOR_KEY.name: floor_key
FLOOR_KEY.description: Floor within the building: numeric floors ('0'-'4'...) plus basement/sublevel codes like 'D6','D7','G6'. References SPACE_FLOOR lookup.

ROOM_COUNTER.name: room_counter
ROOM_COUNTER.description: Constant value 1 in all rows; likely a row-counting flag (one room per row) used for aggregation counts. No variation, so meaning beyond a constant is unresolved.

ROOM_NUMBER.name: room_number
ROOM_NUMBER.description: Room number within the building, including suffixes (e.g. '36E', '94B', '51D'); combined with building number forms BUILDING_ROOM.

ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.name: room_square_footage
ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE.description: Area of the room in square feet (1 to ~108,475; median 147).

SPACE_UNIT_KEY.name: space_unit_key
SPACE_UNIT_KEY.description: Key of the organizational unit (department/DLC) occupying or responsible for the room; references SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY / SPACE_UNIT_CODE.

SPACE_USAGE_KEY.name: space_usage_key
SPACE_USAGE_KEY.description: Space usage classification code; references SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY (e.g. 38='CLNT MEETING ROOM', 71='DINING RM', 87='LIBRARY').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this snapshot.

table.name: SPACE_FLOOR
table.purpose: A small lookup/dimension table of floor codes used in MIT space and facilities data. Each row is one floor code (numeric floors plus basement/sublevel codes like D4, D6, G9). Other tables (SPACE_DETAIL, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD, FCLT_ROOMS_HIST) reference it via FLOOR_KEY to resolve floor codes to floor names. It appears to be a warehouse-generated lookup (single load date) rather than an authoritative facilities table like FAC_FLOOR/FCLT_FLOOR, whose contents are not visible here so the relationship to those tables is unconfirmed.

FLOOR.name: Floor code
FLOOR.description: The floor code within a building, e.g. '0', '1', '17', '29' for numbered floors and codes like 'D6', 'G9' presumably for basement/sub-level or mezzanine floors (exact meaning of the letter prefixes is not evidenced here). Duplicates FLOOR_KEY exactly.

FLOOR_KEY.name: Floor key
FLOOR_KEY.description: Primary key of the lookup; the floor code used by SPACE_DETAIL.FLOOR_KEY, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.FLOOR and FCLT_ROOMS_HIST.FLOOR to identify a floor. Identical in value to FLOOR.

FLOOR_NAME.name: Floor display name
FLOOR_NAME.description: Human-readable label formed by appending ' Floor' to the floor code, e.g. '17 Floor', 'D4 Floor'. Purely derived from FLOOR/FLOOR_KEY.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse, in DD-MON-YY Oracle format; all rows share '19-DEC-24', indicating a single batch load. Not a business attribute of the floor.

table.name: SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE
table.purpose: Per-person (supervisor) space and research volume metrics: for each MIT employee (by MIT_ID) who supervises others, the square footage of space assigned to their department(s), the research dollars administered, and derived ratios. One row per supervisor (MIT_ID is the primary key). The DEPT_NAMES values (D_EAPS, D_LIBRARIES, D_SLOAN, etc.) are MIT DLC (department/lab/center) codes; a supervisor may span multiple departments (DEPT_COUNT > 1). RESEARCH_VOLUME appears to be research funding dollars (values up to ~9.5M, with negatives likely adjustments/transfers). The NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is likely spurious (statistically accepted but semantically implausible: a count of supervisees matching a space-usage lookup key).

DEPT_COUNT.name: DEPT_COUNT
DEPT_COUNT.description: Number of MIT departments/DLCs the supervisor is associated with; 1 for the vast majority (2020 of 2135), up to 4. Matches the number of comma-separated codes in DEPT_NAMES.

DEPT_NAMES.name: DEPT_NAMES
DEPT_NAMES.description: Comma-separated list of MIT department/DLC codes (e.g. D_EAPS, D_LIBRARIES, D_SLOAN, D_ALUM, D_LFEE) the supervisor belongs to; count matches DEPT_COUNT.

MIT_ID.name: MIT_ID
MIT_ID.description: MIT personal identifier (9-digit) of the supervisor; primary key, one row per person.

NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES.name: NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES
NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES.description: Number of direct reports supervised by this person; ranges 1-121, median 1. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is almost certainly coincidental (a small integer matching a lookup key), not a real reference.

RESEARCH_VOLUME.name: RESEARCH_VOLUME
RESEARCH_VOLUME.description: Research volume (likely dollars) attributed to the supervisor's departments; 0 for ~70% of rows, up to ~9.5M, with negative values likely adjustments or cost transfers. Alternative reading: thousands of dollars. Units not directly evidenced.

RES_VOL_PER_SQFT.name: RES_VOL_PER_SQFT
RES_VOL_PER_SQFT.description: Research volume per square foot (RESEARCH_VOLUME / SQFT, rounded); 0 where SQFT or research volume is 0.

SQFT.name: SQFT
SQFT.description: Square footage of space assigned to the supervisor (or their department's space under their supervision); 0 for 248 rows (no assigned space).

SQFT_PER_RES_VOL.name: SQFT_PER_RES_VOL
SQFT_PER_RES_VOL.description: Square footage per unit of research volume (SQFT / RESEARCH_VOLUME); 0 where SQFT is 0. Alternative reading: the reciprocal ratio RESEARCH_VOLUME / SQFT misnamed, but the column name and sibling columns (RES_VOL_PER_SQFT, SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE) support SQFT divided by research volume.

SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE.name: SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE
SQFT_PER_SUPERVISEE.description: Square footage per supervisee (SQFT / NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES); equals SQFT when there is 1 supervisee, 0 when SQFT is 0.

table.name: SPACE_UNIT
table.purpose: Space-occupying organizational units at MIT (departments, labs, centers, offices) that occupy facility space; a crosswalk between DLC codes, facility organization keys, and HR/space unit codes. Each row is one space-occupying unit (DLC/department).

DLC_KEY.name: DLC key
DLC_KEY.description: Department/Lab/Center (DLC) code, prefixed 'D_', linking the space unit to the master department hierarchy (MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY). Null where the space unit has no DLC mapping.

FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.name: Facilities organization key
FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY.description: Surrogate key for the organization in the facilities system (FCLT_ORGANIZATION / FAC_ORGANIZATION); unique per row here, referenced by FCLT_ROOMS and FCLT_ORGANIZATION_HIST.

SPACE_UNIT.name: Space unit name
SPACE_UNIT.description: Human-readable name of the space-occupying unit (e.g., 'Mechanical Engineering', 'List Visual Arts Center'). Nulls align with DLC_KEY nulls.

SPACE_UNIT_CODE.name: Space unit code
SPACE_UNIT_CODE.description: Numeric HR/space department code (e.g., 266300 for Mechanical Engineering); identical to SPACE_UNIT_KEY in every row. Referenced by SPACE_DETAIL, SPACE_UNIT2, ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD, and matched to HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD in FAC/FCLT_ORGANIZATION.

SPACE_UNIT_KEY.name: Space unit key (primary key)
SPACE_UNIT_KEY.description: Primary key of the table; numerically identical to SPACE_UNIT_CODE (HR department number). Used as the join key into SPACE_DETAIL and SPACE_UNIT2.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load timestamp of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: SPACE_UNIT2
table.purpose: Crosswalk mapping MIT space/occupancy units (departments, labs, and centers) to their DLC (Department, Lab, or Center) keys, with unit codes and names. Appears to be a variant/secondary copy of SPACE_UNIT, likely loaded from the space/facilities system (FAC/FCLT family). One row per space unit (with some duplicates, possibly across fiscal periods or load batches).

DLC_KEY.name: DLC_KEY
DLC_KEY.description: Department, Lab, or Center key (DLC code) identifying the organizational unit that owns/occupies the space, e.g. D_CHANCELLOR, D_MECHE, D_LIT. References MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY.DLC_KEY. Nulls (~5%) likely for units without a mapped DLC.

SPACE_UNIT.name: SPACE_UNIT_NAME
SPACE_UNIT.description: Name of the space unit (department, lab, center, or facility) occupying the space, e.g. 'LITERATURE', 'MCGOVERN INSTITUTE', 'WALLACE ASTRO OB'. Matches FAC_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME.

SPACE_UNIT_CODE.name: SPACE_UNIT_CODE
SPACE_UNIT_CODE.description: Numeric code identifying the space unit; identical in value to SPACE_UNIT_KEY in this table. Joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_CODE / SPACE_UNIT_KEY.

SPACE_UNIT_KEY.name: SPACE_UNIT_KEY
SPACE_UNIT_KEY.description: Numeric key for the space unit; in this table it carries the same values as SPACE_UNIT_CODE (both are the unit's code). Joins to SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a single full-load snapshot.

table.name: SPACE_USAGE
table.purpose: Lookup table of space/room usage category codes (e.g., research room, design studio, training room) used by the facilities space data (referenced by SPACE_DETAIL). Each row is one usage category with a surrogate key and label.

SPACE_USAGE.name: space_usage_label
SPACE_USAGE.description: Short uppercase label describing how a room/space is used (e.g., RSRC RM = resource room, TRNG RM = training room, DSGN STUDIO = design studio, DINING RM = dining room, IT HLPDSK = IT help desk). Abbreviated coded text.

SPACE_USAGE_KEY.name: space_usage_key
SPACE_USAGE_KEY.description: Surrogate primary key for the usage category; joined by SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_USAGE_KEY to classify rooms by usage. Other listed joins are spurious statistical matches on small integers.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' (Dec 19, 2024) for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: STUDENT_DEGREE_PROGRAM
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of MIT degree programs: one row per degree program (degree type + course/department combination), with degree descriptions, course and department identifiers, commencement book labels, and the term range over which the program was offered. It is a catalog of degree programs, not a record of individual students (no student IDs present).

COMMENCEMENT_BK_COURSE_ROMAN.name: commencement_book_course_roman
COMMENCEMENT_BK_COURSE_ROMAN.description: Course number in Roman numerals as printed in the MIT commencement book (e.g. 'Course XII' = Course 12, 'Course VI' = Course 6). Variants like 'Course VI-P' and 'Course FIRST YEAR' are legacy commencement-book labels.

COMMENCEMENT_BK_SEE_ALSO.name: commencement_book_see_also
COMMENCEMENT_BK_SEE_ALSO.description: Cross-reference label used in the commencement book pointing to where this degree is listed (e.g. 'S.M., Without Spec.', 'Ph.D., W.H.O.I.'). Alternative reading: it could instead be a note directing readers to a related degree program entry; the exact semantics is not documented.

COURSE.name: course_number
COURSE.description: MIT course number (department number plus optional program suffix), e.g. '2 M' = Course 2 Mechanical Engineering, '21W', 'SCM 2B'. Corresponds to the Roman-numeral course in the commencement book.

COURSE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: course_last_activity_date
COURSE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last recorded activity/update for this course/program record. Alternative reading: it could be the last term date on which the course itself was offered rather than a record-maintenance timestamp.

COURSE_LEVEL.name: course_level
COURSE_LEVEL.description: Level of the degree program: 'G' = graduate, 'U' = undergraduate.

DEGREE_CODE.name: degree_code
DEGREE_CODE.description: Opaque code identifying the specific degree program, typically degree type + course/option (e.g. 'SMWS2' = S.M. without specification, Course 2; 'SB10B' = S.B. Course 10-B; 'PHD' = Ph.D.).

DEGREE_DESC.name: degree_description
DEGREE_DESC.description: Full official description of the degree program (degree title and field, e.g. 'Master of Science in Management of Technology').

DEGREE_DESC_SHORT.name: degree_description_short
DEGREE_DESC_SHORT.description: Abbreviated version of the degree program description.

DEGREE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: degree_last_activity_date
DEGREE_LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date (DD-MON-YY) of the last recorded activity/update for this degree record. Alternative reading: it could be the last date the degree program was conferred or active rather than a record-maintenance timestamp.

DEGREE_TYPE.name: degree_type_code
DEGREE_TYPE.description: Abbreviation of the degree type: SB (Bachelor of Science), SM (Master of Science), PHD, SCD, ENG, MCP, MBA, etc.

DEGREE_TYPE_DESC.name: degree_type_description
DEGREE_TYPE_DESC.description: Full name of the degree type corresponding to DEGREE_TYPE (e.g. 'Master of Science', 'Doctor of Philosophy').

DEGREE_WEIGHT.name: degree_weight
DEGREE_WEIGHT.description: Numeric weight/rank of the degree type, likely used for ordering or counting highest degree (SB=1, SM=3, ENG=6, PHD/SCD=8). Exact semantics of the scale is not documented.

DEPARTMENT.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT.description: MIT department code (e.g. '12' = Earth, Atmospheric & Planetary Sciences, '6' = EECS, '1' = Civil and Environmental Engineering); references STUDENT_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE.

DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: department_name_in_commencement_book
DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: Department name as printed in the commencement book (includes historical names such as 'Department of Ocean Engineering' and 'Department of Meteorology').

FROM_TERM.name: from_term
FROM_TERM.description: Academic term code (e.g. '1985SP', '2004FA') from which this degree program was valid/offered; '000000' indicates no recorded start term. References ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

IS_DOUBLE_MAJOR.name: is_double_major
IS_DOUBLE_MAJOR.description: Flag indicating whether this degree program counts as a double major ('Y'/'N').

SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.name: school_name_in_commencement_book
SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK.description: MIT school the degree program belongs to, as printed in the commencement book (School of Engineering, School of Science, etc.).

THRU_TERM.name: thru_term
THRU_TERM.description: Academic term code through which this degree program was valid; '999999' indicates still active/open-ended. References ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; single value '19-DEC-24' for all rows, indicating a full refresh on that date.

table.name: STUDENT_DEPARTMENT
table.purpose: Lookup table of MIT academic departments (by course number code) and the school/college each belongs to, used to classify students and subjects by department. Includes non-MIT and special program entries (cross-enrollment, undesignated, etc.).

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Department code (MIT course number)
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Primary key. MIT course-number code for the department ('1' Civil & Environmental Engineering, '12' EAPS, '21L' Literature, etc.), plus alphabetic codes for special/non-MIT programs (NIT = Tufts cross-enrollment, NIV, WCD, CDO, UND). Referenced by student, subject, and degree-program tables.

DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.name: Department code with abbreviated name
DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.description: Composite display string: department code prefixed to an abbreviated department name, e.g. '12-Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci'. One-to-one with SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable department or program name without the code ('Earth, Atmos & Planetary Sci', 'Tufts Cross-Enrollment Prog'). 'Biological Engineering' appears twice, likely two codes (e.g. Course 20 and a variant) sharing the same name.

SCHOOL_CODE.name: School code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Single-letter code for the school/college the department belongs to: E=Engineering, H=Humanities, Arts & Social Sciences, S=Science, Z=Non-MIT, Y=MIT academic, T and others (e.g. Whitaker/HST, Schwarzman College of Computing).

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Full name of the school corresponding to SCHOOL_CODE ('Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Non-MIT', 'Science', 'Whitaker Coll of HST; HST', 'Schwarzman Coll of Comp').

table.name: STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP
table.purpose: A lookup/dimension table mapping federal/IPEDS-style ethnic group codes to finer ethnic subgroups (e.g. Asian -> China, Hispanic -> Puerto Rico). One row per ethnic subgroup within a group; the composite key is ETHNIC_CODE:ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE. The join to SPACE_USAGE is spurious (coincidental numeric overlap) and should be ignored.

ETHNIC_CODE.name: ethnic_group_code
ETHNIC_CODE.description: Two-digit code for the broad ethnic/racial group (10=Black or African American, 20=American Indian or Alaskan Native, 30=Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, 40=Hispanic or Latino, 50=Asian, 80/90=other/unknown). Matches the prefix of ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE. The accepted join to SPACE_USAGE.SPACE_USAGE_KEY is a coincidental numeric match, not a real reference.

ETHNIC_GROUP_NAME.name: ethnic_group_name
ETHNIC_GROUP_NAME.description: Human-readable label of the broad ethnic/racial group corresponding to ETHNIC_CODE (e.g. 'Asian', 'Hispanic or Latino').

ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE.name: ethnic_subgroup_code
ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE.description: Four-digit code for the specific ethnic subgroup; first two digits equal the parent ETHNIC_CODE (e.g. 5001 = Asian/China). Unique within the table.

ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_NAME.name: ethnic_subgroup_name
ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_NAME.description: Label of the specific ethnic subgroup (e.g. 'China', 'Puerto Rico', 'Sioux', 'African American'); 'Other' appears multiple times across different groups, hence 42 distinct values for 46 rows.

STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_KEY.name: student_ethnic_subgroup_key
STUDENT_ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_KEY.description: Primary key: concatenation of ETHNIC_CODE and ETHNIC_SUBGROUP_CODE ('group:subgroup', e.g. '50:5001').

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE
table.purpose: Lookup table of subject (course) attribute codes used in MIT's course catalog (e.g., HASS, GIR, communication-requirement, tuition, lab-unit, and enrollment-restriction attributes). Each row defines one attribute code with its descriptions; referenced by course catalog tables to classify subjects.

LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.name: last_activity_date
LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE.description: Date the attribute record was last created or updated in the source system, stored as text in DD-MON-YY Oracle format. Values span 1993–2022, indicating per-row maintenance dates.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.name: subject_attribute_code
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_CODE.description: Primary key: short code identifying a subject attribute (e.g., HASS codes, GIR requirement codes, lab-unit codes, tuition/supervisor attributes). Referenced by course catalog tables (COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED, DRUPAL_COURSE_CATALOG, CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE) as GIR_ATTRIBUTE, HASS_ATTRIBUTE, COMM_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, WRITE_REQ_ATTRIBUTE, TUITION_ATTRIBUTE, SUPERVISOR_ATTRIBUTE.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.name: subject_attribute_description
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_DESC.description: Full human-readable description of the attribute code (e.g., 'HASS Arts', 'Calculus I', 'Not for Cross Reg Harvard', 'Comm Reqt - Expository Writing').

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_REPORT_DESC.name: subject_attribute_report_description
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_REPORT_DESC.description: Alternate abbreviated description used for reports; populated only for a small subset (9 rows), mostly Humanities-Distribution codes (HD-1 through HD-5, HD-L, LINKED). Exact report context is not evidenced.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_SHORT_DESC.name: subject_attribute_short_description
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_SHORT_DESC.description: Short/abbreviated description of the attribute (e.g., 'HASS-A', 'Half Inst Lab', 'Sloan Core'), populated for about 60% of rows.

SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE.name: subject_attribute_type
SUBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE.description: Two-valued flag classifying the attribute record; 'A' (94 rows) vs 'N' (10 rows). Likely active vs. non-active/inactive, but the exact meaning of the values is not directly evidenced.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse (DD-MON-YY text); constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows, i.e., the date of the last full load of this table.

table.name: SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE
table.purpose: Enrollable subjects (courses) per academic term, grouped under a master subject cluster (HAA.0000). Each row is one subject offered in one term, with its cluster membership, offering department/school codes, and title. Data appears to be a single cluster of Harvard-style subject IDs (HAA.xxxx) across terms 2011SP-2013FA, loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24. Likely a bridge/summary table linking individual subject offerings to a master subject grouping (cf. SUBJECT_GROUPING, SUBJECT_OFFERED).

CLUSTER_LIST.name: cluster_member_list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs belonging to the same master subject cluster as this row's subject; truncated with an ellipsis. Varies by term, reflecting the cluster's membership in that term.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the master/cluster subject that groups the enrollable subjects; constant 'HAA.0000' in this extract.

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: offering_department_code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department offering the subject; constant 'NIH' in this extract (likely a Harvard dept code, not NIH the institute). Alternative reading: could be a school-level code, but the parallel OFFER_SCHOOL_CODE column argues against that.

SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.name: subject_group_id
SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.description: Opaque surrogate key identifying the subject group/cluster for a given term; one value per term, matching TERM_CODE 1:1 in this extract. Likely joins to SUBJECT_GROUPING, but no accepted join is documented for this column, so the exact target remains unconfirmed.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the individual enrollable subject (course), format HAA.xxxx; repeats across terms (each subject appears once per term offered).

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Short title of the subject, often prefixed with course number (e.g. 'VES 50: Filmmaking').

SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG.name: subject_title_long
SUBJECT_TITLE_LONG.description: Long title of the subject; identical to SUBJECT_TITLE in all observed rows.

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term in which the subject is enrollable, format YYYY + FA/SP (e.g. 2012FA). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: ultimate_master_subject_id
ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the top-level master subject in the grouping hierarchy; equals MASTER_SUBJECT_ID ('HAA.0000') in this extract, suggesting a single-level hierarchy here. Alternative reading: a redundant copy of MASTER_SUBJECT_ID rather than a distinct hierarchy level.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' (Oracle DD-MON-YY format) for this extract.

table.name: SUBJECT_GROUPING
table.purpose: Maps MIT academic departments (code, name, school) to academic terms, one row per department-term combination, presumably indicating which departments had subjects offered (or were grouped for reporting) in each term. The surrogate key suggests a warehouse dimension/bridge table.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: department_code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT course/department number code (e.g. '2' = Mechanical Engineering, '6' = EECS, '15' = Management; also non-numeric codes like 'MAS', 'NIV', 'AS').

DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.name: department_full_name
DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.description: Department code prefixed to its name, e.g. '2-Mechanical Engineering'. Joins to SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: department_name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Human-readable department name without the code prefix (e.g. 'Architecture').

SCHOOL_NAME.name: school_name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: MIT school the department belongs to (Engineering, Science, Sloan, Architecture and Planning, Hum/Arts & Social Sciences, plus special categories like 'Non-MIT', 'MIT, non-academic', HST, Schwarzman College).

SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.name: subject_grouping_key
SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.description: Surrogate primary key for the department-term grouping row; mostly hex warehouse-generated keys, with a few legacy values like '1994SP66.196' (term + department code pattern).

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term code in YYYY{SP,FA,SU,JA} format (e.g. 2022SP, 2016SU, 2001JA = January IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE.

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load timestamp of the row into the warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for all rows in this snapshot.

table.name: SUBJECT_IAP_SCHEDULE
table.purpose: Meeting/session schedule for MIT Independent Activities Period (IAP) January 2021 non-credit subjects: for each session, its date, start/end times, meeting location (mostly virtual/Zoom), and registration or Zoom-link remarks. Likely a detail table under IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL/IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION, though no join keys are populated in this snapshot.

IAP_DATE.name: IAP session date
IAP_DATE.description: Date of the IAP meeting/session, stored as text in DD-MON-YY format (e.g. 14-JAN-21). All dates fall in January 2021, consistent with IAP.

MEET_END_TIME.name: Meeting end time
MEET_END_TIME.description: End time of the session as text in HHMMPM format (e.g. 0300PM = 3:00 PM).

MEET_PLACE.name: Meeting location
MEET_PLACE.description: Where the session meets; free text dominated by virtual locations (Zoom, Virtual, Online) with inconsistent capitalization, plus room names.

MEET_START_TIME.name: Meeting start time
MEET_START_TIME.description: Start time of the session as text in HHMMPM format (e.g. 0100PM = 1:00 PM).

REMARKS.name: Registration/remarks
REMARKS.description: Free-text notes, mostly registration instructions (Handshake, Google forms) and Zoom meeting links/IDs for the session.

TERM_CODE.name: Academic term code
TERM_CODE.description: Term of the schedule; single value 2021JA = January/IAP term of academic year 2021 (matches ACADEMIC_TERMS-style codes).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: ETL load date when the row was loaded into the warehouse (19-DEC-24 for all rows), not a business date.

table.name: SUBJECT_OFFERED
table.purpose: One row per subject offering (course section) per term, as recorded in MIT's data warehouse. This extract contains only Harvard cross-enrollment (HAA) subjects offered to MIT students via the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program, one row per subject per academic term (e.g. 2014JA = January/Spring, SU = Summer). The table tracks the subject's identity, term, cluster/grouping, section flags, enrollment counts, and offering department/school.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Cluster enrollment number
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Enrollment number assigned to the cluster (group of related subjects) this offering belongs to; always 0 in this extract, so no meaningful enrollment is recorded at cluster level.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: Cluster member list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs (HAA.xxxx) belonging to the same cluster/grouping as this offering, prefixed by the master subject HAA.0000.

CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Cluster type code
CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Code for the type of subject cluster; 'S' in all rows.

CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.name: Cluster type description
CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.description: Description of CLUSTER_TYPE; 'S' = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' (Harvard school-wide electives).

COURSE_NUMBER.name: Course (subject code prefix)

COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: Course number description

EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT.name: Evaluate this subject flag

HGN_CODE.name: Graduate credit level code

HGN_CODE_DESC.name: Graduate credit level description
HGN_CODE_DESC.description: Description of HGN_CODE: 'Not for graduate credit', 'Graduate program', 'Higher level graduate program'.

IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE.name: Created by data warehouse flag

IS_DESIGN_SECTION.name: Is design section flag

IS_LAB_SECTION.name: Is lab section flag
IS_LAB_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a laboratory section; always 'N'.

IS_LECTURE_SECTION.name: Is lecture section flag
IS_LECTURE_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a lecture section; always 'N'.

IS_OSE_SUBJECT.name: Is OSE subject flag

IS_RECITATION_SECTION.name: Is recitation section flag
IS_RECITATION_SECTION.description: Y/N flag indicating whether this section is a recitation section; always 'N'.

IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT.name: Is repeatable subject flag

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER.name: Master course number

MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.name: Master course number description
MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC.description: Description of MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER: 'Harvard, Arts and Sciences'.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the master/parent subject of the cluster; constant 'HAA.0000'.

MASTER_SUBJECT_KEY.name: Master subject key

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: Number of enrolled students

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: Offering department code

OFFER_DEPT_NAME.name: Offering department name
OFFER_DEPT_NAME.description: Name of the offering department: 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog'.

OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.name: Offering school name
OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.description: School of the offering institution; 'Non-MIT' for all rows.

SECTION_ID.name: Section ID
SECTION_ID.description: Identifier of the section within the subject offering; always '0' (the master/only section) in this extract.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Subject enrollment number
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Enrollment number assigned to the subject offering; always 0 in this extract.

SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.name: Subject grouping key
SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.description: Opaque warehouse key identifying the subject grouping/cluster the offering belongs to (one key per master subject + term).

SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the subject (course) being offered, e.g. HAA.5243; 2081 distinct Harvard subjects in this extract.

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Subject ID sort key
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of SUBJECT_ID; identical values.

SUBJECT_KEY.name: Subject key
SUBJECT_KEY.description: Primary key of the table: warehouse key for the subject offering = subject code + zero-padded subject number + year + term (e.g. HAA52430002014JA). Unique per row.

SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject offered summary key
SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Key linking to the SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY table: subject ID + year + term (e.g. HAA.52432014JA).

SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject summary key
SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Key linking to the SUBJECT_SUMMARY table: subject ID + year + term; identical to SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY in this extract.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject as offered, e.g. 'English 10b:British Writers II', 'Historical Study A-13:China'.

TERM_CODE.name: Term code

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: Warehouse load date

table.name: SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY
table.purpose: One row per subject offering (subject x academic term) in MIT's course/subject data warehouse, summarizing enrollment, credit units, offering department/school, cluster (joint/meeting-together) grouping, and responsible faculty for each subject taught in a given term. Includes MIT subjects and cross-enrolled subjects from Harvard, Wellesley, etc. (Non-MIT).

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: cluster_enrollment_total
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Total enrollment across the whole cluster (group of subjects meeting together / school-wide elective set) that this subject belongs to. Null when the subject is not part of a cluster.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: cluster_member_subject_ids
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs (e.g. HAA.0000, HAA.0018) belonging to the same cluster/meeting-together group. Null when not in a cluster.

CLUSTER_TYPE.name: cluster_type_code
CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Code for how the subject is grouped with others: S = school-wide electives, M = meeting together, J = joint subject. Null when not clustered.

CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.name: cluster_type_description
CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.description: Plain-text description of CLUSTER_TYPE: 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', 'Meeting Together', 'Joint subject'.

COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY.name: composite_subject_key
COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY.description: Key of the cluster's master/composite subject (master subject ID + term code, e.g. HAA.00002016SP); for unclustered subjects it equals the subject's own key.

COURSE_NUMBER.name: course_number
COURSE_NUMBER.description: Subject code prefix (department/course number, e.g. HAA, 14, 18) identifying the course the subject belongs to; references SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.

HGN_CODE.name: graduate_level_code
HGN_CODE.description: Code for graduate-credit level of the subject: H = higher level graduate program, G = graduate program, N = not for graduate credit.

LAB_UNITS.name: lab_units
LAB_UNITS.description: Credit units attributable to laboratory work for the subject (MIT units; typical values 0, 1, 3, 6, 12, up to 24).

LECTURE_UNITS.name: lecture_units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Credit units attributable to lecture/recitation for the subject (0-24; most subjects have 0-4).

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: master_subject_id
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Subject ID of the cluster's master/composite subject (e.g. HAA.0000); equals the subject's own ID when unclustered.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: master_subject_id_sort
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of MASTER_SUBJECT_ID (padded/normalized for ordering).

NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.name: enrolled_student_count
NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS.description: Number of students enrolled in this subject offering for the term (0-432; 0 for most rows, likely cross-enrollment/non-MIT offerings).

OFFER_DEPT_CODE.name: offering_department_code
OFFER_DEPT_CODE.description: Code of the department offering the subject (e.g. NIH = Harvard Cross-Enrollment, 14 = Economics, HST = Health Sciences & Technology).

OFFER_DEPT_NAME.name: offering_department_name
OFFER_DEPT_NAME.description: Name of the department offering the subject (e.g. 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog', 'Economics').

OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.name: offering_school_name
OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school the offering department belongs to (e.g. 'Engineering', 'Science', 'Non-MIT').

PREPARATION_UNITS.name: preparation_units
PREPARATION_UNITS.description: Credit units attributable to preparation/outside work for the subject (0-18).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.name: responsible_faculty_mit_id
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID.description: MIT ID number of the faculty member responsible for the subject offering; null for ~71% of rows (mostly non-MIT/cross-enrolled offerings).

RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.name: responsible_faculty_name
RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME.description: Name ('Last, First') of the responsible faculty member; null when no responsible faculty is recorded.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: subject_enrollment_count
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Number of students enrolled in this subject offering; identical to NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS in this extract.

SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.name: subject_grouping_key
SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY.description: Opaque surrogate key (hex string) identifying the subject's grouping/cluster record; likely joins to SUBJECT_GROUPING. No accepted join is documented for this column, so this reading remains plausible but unconfirmed.

SUBJECT_ID.name: subject_id
SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the subject (course number + catalog number, e.g. 14.383, HAA.2492).

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: subject_id_sort
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: Sort-friendly version of SUBJECT_ID (space-padded so numeric course numbers sort correctly).

SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.name: subject_offering_key
SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Primary key: SUBJECT_ID concatenated with TERM_CODE (e.g. HAA.24922014FA), uniquely identifying one subject offering in one term.

SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.name: subject_summary_key
SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.description: Same value as SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY (subject ID + term code); duplicate/alternate key column.

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: subject_title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject as offered (e.g. 'Econometrics II'); for cross-enrolled courses includes the host school's catalog number.

TERM_CODE.name: term_code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering in YYYY + session format (FA fall, SP spring, SU summer, JA January/IAP); references ACADEMIC_TERMS.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: total_credit_units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (lecture + lab + preparation; typical 12, 6, 3, 1).

WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.name: warehouse_load_date
WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE.description: Date the row was loaded into the data warehouse; constant '19-DEC-24' for this extract.

table.name: SUBJECT_SUMMARY
table.purpose: Per-term enrollment summary for each MIT (and cross-enrolled Harvard) course subject: unit breakdown, department/school, and enrollment counts for the subject itself and for the 'cluster' (group of related subjects, e.g. school-wide electives) it belongs to. One row per subject per term (key = subject + term).

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.name: Cluster enrollment, first week, for-credit
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.description: Enrollment count at first week across all subjects in the cluster, counting students taking the subject for credit.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.name: Cluster enrollment, first week, listeners
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.description: Enrollment count at first week across the cluster, counting students listening (auditing) the subject.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.name: Cluster enrollment, fifth week, for-credit
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.description: Enrollment count at fifth week across the cluster, for-credit students.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.name: Cluster enrollment, fifth week, listeners
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.description: Enrollment count at fifth week across the cluster, listening (auditing) students.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.name: Cluster enrollment, for-credit
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.description: Enrollment count across all subjects in the cluster counting for-credit students. Likely the final/end-of-term figure, but could be another census point; the paired CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN and CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER suggest it is the final for-credit component.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.name: Cluster enrollment, fifth week, total
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listen) across the cluster at the fifth-week census.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.name: Cluster enrollment, first week, total
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listen) across the cluster at the first-week census.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.name: Cluster enrollment, listeners
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.description: Enrollment count across the cluster counting listening (auditing) students. Likely the final/end-of-term figure, but could be another census point; it is the listener counterpart of CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.

CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Cluster enrollment, total
CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Total enrollment across the cluster (credit + listen), likely the final/current figure (CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT + CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN). Null when the subject is not part of a cluster. Could alternatively be a different census point, but the first/fifth-week totals have their own columns.

CLUSTER_LIST.name: Cluster subject list
CLUSTER_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of subject IDs belonging to the same cluster (e.g. school-wide elective group). Null when no cluster.

CLUSTER_TYPE.name: Cluster type code
CLUSTER_TYPE.description: Code for the cluster type: S = School-Wide Electives, J = Joint subject, M = Meeting Together; blank when no cluster.

CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.name: Cluster type description
CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC.description: Human-readable cluster type: 'SWE: School-Wide Electives', 'Joint subject', 'Meeting Together'.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.name: Department code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: MIT course/department code (e.g. 15 = Management, 1 = Civil & Environmental Eng); NIH = Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program. References STUDENT_DEPARTMENT / SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.name: Department name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Name of the owning department (e.g. 'Management', 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog').

DESIGN_UNITS.name: Design units
DESIGN_UNITS.description: Design portion of the subject's credit units (MIT units are lecture+lab+prep; design is a further breakdown). Almost always 0.

LAB_UNITS.name: Lab units
LAB_UNITS.description: Laboratory hours/units component of the subject's total MIT units.

LECTURE_UNITS.name: Lecture units
LECTURE_UNITS.description: Lecture hours/units component of the subject's total MIT units.

MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Master subject ID
MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.description: Identifier of the master/parent subject for the cluster (e.g. HAA.0000 for the Harvard cross-enrollment umbrella); equals SUBJECT_ID when the subject stands alone.

PREP_UNITS.name: Preparation units
PREP_UNITS.description: Preparation/homework hours component of the subject's total MIT units.

SCHOOL_CODE.name: School code
SCHOOL_CODE.description: Code of the MIT school owning the subject: E=Engineering, H=Humanities/Arts/Social Sciences, S=Science, A=Architecture and Planning, Z=Non-MIT, etc.

SCHOOL_NAME.name: School name
SCHOOL_NAME.description: Name of the school: 'Engineering', 'Hum, Arts & Social Sciences', 'Science', 'Non-MIT', etc.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.name: Subject enrollment, first week, for-credit
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT.description: Enrollment count for this individual subject at first week, for-credit students.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.name: Subject enrollment, first week, listeners
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_LISTEN.description: Enrollment count for this individual subject at first week, listening (auditing) students.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.name: Subject enrollment, fifth week, for-credit
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT.description: Enrollment count for this individual subject at fifth week, for-credit students.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.name: Subject enrollment, fifth week, listeners
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_LISTEN.description: Enrollment count for this individual subject at fifth week, listening students.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.name: Subject enrollment, for-credit
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.description: Enrollment count for this individual subject counting for-credit students. Likely the final/end-of-term figure, but could be another census point; it is the for-credit counterpart of SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.name: Subject enrollment, fifth week, total
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listen) for this subject at the fifth-week census.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.name: Subject enrollment, first week, total
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK.description: Total enrollment (credit + listen) for this subject at the first-week census.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.name: Subject enrollment, listeners
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN.description: Enrollment count for this individual subject counting listening (auditing) students. Likely the final/end-of-term figure, but could be another census point; it is the listener counterpart of SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT.

SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.name: Subject enrollment, total
SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER.description: Total enrollment (credit + listen) for this individual subject, likely the final/current figure (SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT + SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN). Could alternatively be a different census point, but the first/fifth-week totals have their own columns.

SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.name: Subject group ID
SUBJECT_GROUP_ID.description: Opaque surrogate key identifying the subject group/cluster, shared by all subjects in the same cluster. SUBJECT_ID.name: Subject ID
SUBJECT_ID.description: MIT subject code (e.g. 8.18, HAA.3405); HAA/HAB/... are Harvard cross-enrollment subjects.

SUBJECT_ID_SORT.name: Subject ID, sort form
SUBJECT_ID_SORT.description: SUBJECT_ID formatted for correct sorting (space-padded numeric part).

SUBJECT_OR_CLUSTER.name: Subject or cluster identifier

SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY.name: Subject summary key

SUBJECT_TITLE.name: Subject title
SUBJECT_TITLE.description: Title of the subject (e.g. 'Econ 1402:Central Bankng', 'Undergraduate Research').

TERM_CODE.name: Term code
TERM_CODE.description: Academic term of the offering, format YYYY + FA/SP/SU/JA (fall/spring/summer/January IAP). References ACADEMIC_TERMS.

TOTAL_UNITS.name: Total units
TOTAL_UNITS.description: Total MIT credit units for the subject (lecture + lab + prep).

ULT_MASTER_SUBJECT_ID.name: Ultimate master subject ID
